func_800F1EA4.about:
The CPU's general chooser (ai_choose_in_ring, ai_choose_elsewhere, ai_choose_away_from_ring and the SPECIAL-ready checks call it): picks a plan for the slot being decided (*0x8015A6F0) by its target's situation (AI +0x48, ai_situation_code), its skill roll (chance_in_1000(AI +0x20)) and whether the target is near (AI +0x60 under the double at 0x8014ECC0).
Near: armed (his +0xEF bit 0) with 0x8016B9E0 3 (or 2 with place bit 0x100), the target not in a state step (+0x80 bit 0): on the roll plan 22 (a lying target, situation 15, out of his reach +0x7C < +0x68 gives 48) or 9 (70%) / 6; off it 41 on a second roll, else 32. Otherwise by situation: 15 ai_choose_at_lying_target; 16, 19, 22, 23 ai_choose_at_rising_target; 8 / 11 (striking / in a grapple; the roll scaled by 0x8014ED78, or 0x8014ED80 with the target's +0x78 & 0x44) ai_answer_target_strike / ai_answer_target_grapple, off the roll the table 0x801452F4 or plan 41; 17 ai_use_special_or_pick_b; 18 _c; 24 ai_use_special_or_pick; 45 plan 32; 2 nothing; any other: on the apron (place bit 2) the table 0x80145330, the target in a state step plan 32, else ai_choose_at_target_near.
Far: the target in a state step -> plan 32 off the roll, 48 on it; armed as above -> 48 for a lying target, 10 on the roll, else the table 0x80145318; else on the roll: 15 / 16 / 19 -> 50 with his SPECIAL lit, else ai_choose_at_down_target_far (both in the ring) or plan 48; 17 / 22 / 23, 18, 24 as near; 8 / 11 the answers on the scaled roll; and last -- or off the roll -- on two more rolls (0x80145354 by 0x8016B93C, then 10%) ai_choose_running_attack_plan(1), else the table 0x80145348 with SPECIAL lit or ready (+0xEE & 6), or 0x80145318 (ai_pick_plan_from_table). (2026-11-12, from the code; plan numbers in decimal.)
func_800F1EA4.name: ai_choose_by_target_situation

func_800F2028.about: The story scenes' panels into the display list at *`display_list` (draw_scene_overlays calls it while the panel set *0x8010660C is set). First the set's script (*(0x80102BDC + 4 x set): 3-byte entries {kind under 13, a u16 of place and flags}) updates the 13 panel records at 0x80104C50 (8 bytes each: +0 x, +2 the target place and flags, +4 y, +5 the target y, +6 the slide / fade counter, stepped by 0x20); then each panel with a counter is drawn: slid between its place and its target by the counter when +2 has 0x100, with that alpha (G_SETPRIMCOLOR alpha, G_SETENVCOLOR white), and by kind: 0 / 8 a text (func_800DD740 of 0xF6A8 + ...) squeezed to width (draw_text_squeezed_to_width), 1 a number with its prefix (prefixed_number_text), 2 a Superstar's name (superstar_name; the story's champion 0x80097EEC / 0x80097EFC), 3 draw_story_money_panel, 4 a big number (draw_big_font_text_at), 5 a text, 6 a text box (count_text_lines, a darkened draw_screen_rectangle, the lines with skip_text_line, text 0xF6A7), 7 draw_story_chart_panel, 9 text 0xF6A1, 10 texts 0xF6A2 / 0xF6A3 / 0xF6A4 and a choice list (draw_choice_lines), 11 the big text 0xF6A5, 12 a full-screen rectangle with texts 0xF69C / 0xF69D / 0xF6A4. (2026-11-12, from the code and its callees; the panels' texts by their IDs only.)
func_800F2028.name: draw_story_panels

func_800F2428.about: ai_choose_in_ring calls it when the target is SPECIAL-ready (his +0xEE & 4): on the skill roll (+0x20), with the place bit 0x100, the two in different quadrants (+0x42 / +0x54) and the target far (+0x60): unarmed and on a personality roll (0x8014536C by the byte 0x8016B9E0, times a moveset factor 0x80145384) plan 101 (presses C-left); else on a second roll plans 34 / 33 when neither was used lately (was_recent_plan, func_800F0E0C); otherwise, not a tag man (+0xE9 & 3 clear), on another roll plan 45 or 41. Returns 1 when it set a plan. Reading: keep away from a man with his SPECIAL ready. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: plan 0x65 (101) unless he holds something (+held_flags & 1) or the personality roll fails, then 0x22 / 0x21 (34 / 33, even odds) when was_recent_plan(0x23, 5) is 0, else 0x2D / 0x29 (45, or 41 at 250 in 1000) through ai_set_plan; returns 1 when a plan was set.)
func_800F2428.name: ai_react_to_target_special

func_800F25D4.about: ai_choose_by_target_situation (func_800F1EA4)'s default for a near target in a situation without its own chooser (3-7, 9, 10, 12-14, 20, 21, 25-44) when the target is not in a state step (+0x80 bit 0): plans by not_behind_him, ai_chance_by_target_stamina, the skill roll and SPECIAL. Situation codes (the AI record +0x48, the target's; +0x24 his own): ai_situation_code (func_800FCBB0) maps a wrestler's state to them (jump table 0x8014F850); structs.md lists them. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the base chance is the skill chance x the float 0x80145.. by *0x8016B93C, scaled by 0x8014EE08 (SPECIAL ready), 0x8014EE10 (lit), 0x8014EE18 (on the apron with AI flag 0x40), 0x8014EE20 (outside, personality 2).)
func_800F25D4.name: ai_choose_at_target_near

func_800F2860.about: 0x8010660C = `set`: which list of panels draw_story_panels (func_800F2028) draws (0x80102BDC[set] -> 4-byte entries {kind 0-12, x, u16 y / flags}, 0xD ends; kinds draw text, numbers, Superstar names, big-font text, ...). Callers play_scene_script (4), wait_scene_command (0xB), run_front_end_sequence_step (func_800EA774), run_story_page_frame (func_800EF258_ovl_a).
func_800F2860.name: set_scene_panel_set

func_800F286C.about: Clears the scene overlays (caller allocate_text_requests): frame count 0x80106158, text 0x801066E0, picture script 0x80106674 = -1 (0x80104C30 -1, 0x80104C48 0), panel set 0x8010660C = -1, text bank 0x80106630 = -1, and the 13 panels' timers (0x80104C50 + i x 8, +6).
func_800F286C.name: reset_scene_overlays

func_800F28CC.about: The scene overlays into the display list at *`list`: the story text box (draw_story_text_box (func_800F00C0), while text 0x801066E0 is set), the panels (draw_story_panels (func_800F2028), set 0x8010660C) and the picture script (draw_picture_script (func_800F0748), while 0x80106674 >= 0). Callers draw_scene_front_layer, draw_menu_text_queue.
func_800F28CC.name: draw_scene_overlays

func_800F28E0.about: A yes / no roll (chance_in_1000) whose odds grow with the AI record's +0x4C, the noisy reading of the target's stamina (ai_update_estimates), clamped to 100..250 and scaled by the constant at 0x8014EE38. Called by ai_choose_at_target_near. (2026-11-12, names4: confirmed from the lifted C++: the name says only what the code does).
func_800F28E0.name: ai_chance_by_target_stamina

func_800F2968.about: AI (the CPU slot *0x8015A6F0): chooses between the two running attacks. When he is in place (+0x82 & 0x101) and free (target state checks), looks at his moveset (+0x88, 0x24-byte entries) for the slots listed at 0x801453B4 (4) and 0x801453BC (2) having flag 0x8000; by which have it the chance is 800, 200 or 500 in 1000 (none: by difficulty 0x801453C0[*0x80159980]); on success plan 10 (ai_plan_10_running_strike; ai_set_plan_2 when `flags` & 2), else plan 3 (ai_plan_3_run_attack). Which moves the listed slots are is not established. Callers ai_choose_in_ring and other plan choosers. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: found is 1 for a flagged slot in the first list, + 2 in the second; chance 800 / 200 / 500 for 1 / 2 / 3, the halfword table 0x801453C0 by the signed byte *0x80159980 for none; not in place (or the target checks fail) is plan 10 through ai_set_plan.)
func_800F2968.name: ai_choose_running_attack_plan

func_800F2B04.about: When the target (*0x80159618) holds a weapon (his +0xEF & 1, read so from take_held_object (func_801426CC), which moves +0xEF with the held object +0x3C), the AI's situation (+0x48) is 2 and the target faces the CPU (angle_to from 0x8016B9C0 to 0x80159674 within 0xAA of his facing +0x10C): plan 95 (holds R) on the chance roll of the AI's +0x20, else a pick from the table 0x801453CC (ai_pick_plan_from_table); returns 1 then, else 0. (2026-11-12, names2: confirmed from the lifted C++.)
func_800F2B04.name: ai_defend_against_armed_target

func_800F2BBC.about: The CPU's chooser for its man in the ring with the target on the floor outside (AI record +0x82 place bit 4; ai_choose_by_place calls it). Nothing when ai_try_special_choosers acted. When either man is not taking part (+0xE9 & 0x10): with +0x96 & 0xC0 plan 41 or 32 (even odds), else plan 36. In a tag match, when every other man is outside too and neither plan 33 nor 34 was used in the last 10 (was_recent_plan): plan 36. Otherwise two chances from the personality byte 0x8016B9E0 (0x80145400, + 150 under rule 0x4000 (0x800A9950), and 0x801453F4), scaled by 0x8014EE40 / 0x8014EE48 when he or the target has SPECIAL (+0xEE & 4); situation 38 tries the corner plan (ai_try_corner_plan); on the skill roll by the target's situation: 15 lying -> ai_pick_dive_at_lying_target_outside, 16 / 19 rising -> ai_pick_dive_at_rising_target_outside, 17 / 18 and others halved, 11 grappling him -> plan 44 near on a roll from 0x8014540C; then the dive over the ropes (ai_try_dive_over_ropes(2), 300 in 1000) or the rising pick, else by the count-out (*0x8016B594 against 0x8014526C / 0x80145278 by the byte 0x800A9462) plan 36 (follow him out) unless 33 / 34 were recent; else plan 49 on a roll from 0x80145414 without SPECIAL lit, else the plan table 0x801453E0 (ai_pick_plan_from_table). Failing the skill roll: plan 36. (2026-11-12, names3: rewritten and confirmed from the lifted C++; the old about only said which place bit leads here.)
func_800F2BBC.name: ai_choose_in_ring_target_outside

func_800F312C.about: The CPU chooser for place bit 0x20 of the AI record +0x82 (ai_update_estimates sets it from the two men's +0x82: he on the apron, the target neither in the ring nor on the apron, i.e. on the floor outside). Under rule 0x400 the legal man (+0xE9 bit 4) takes plan 33 at once; otherwise the special choosers first (ai_try_special_choosers); in a tag match (AI +0x80 bit 5) a man who is not free to act (non_legal_man_free_to_act) with a target who is not the legal man gets plan 35 (back through the ropes); a target in situation 38 tries ai_try_corner_plan; a tag man off his own corner walks back (60). Then, on the skill roll, with two chances from the personality tables 0x8014541C (attack) and 0x80145428 (+150 under rule 0x4000; the run plans): with the two men on different sides (+0x42 != +0x54) plan 33 or 35 (not among the last 10 plans) on the run chance; on the same side, by the target's situation (15 lying, 16 / 19 rising (19 on the personality chance 0x80145434 can give the taunt 49 with SPECIAL ready), 17 / 18 halved; ai_option_byte_is_2 adds 200-300), the attack chance tries a dive from the apron (ai_try_dive_from_apron, 50%) or a turnbuckle dive (ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan, by the moveset +0x38 bits 0x80 / 0x100); failing that the run chance gives 33 / 35, and otherwise plan 104 (walk along the apron), or 33 when plan 35 / 36 was recent or he is the legal man. (2026-11-12, names4: rewritten from the lifted C++; the old about named only the place bit.)
func_800F312C.name: ai_choose_on_apron_target_outside

func_800F356C.about: The AI record +0x82 place bit is the one ai_update_estimates (func_800FD188) sets from the two men's record +0x82 (1 the ring, 2 the apron, 4 the floor outside, 0x400 the cage wall): 8 (he on the apron, the target in the ring); 21 chance rolls, ai_choose_on_apron_in_tag_match (func_800F3D70) and the move-pick helpers ai_try_switch_target (func_800F4BAC) / ai_try_switch_target_in_tag_match (func_800F51E4) / ai_marked_man_check (func_800F5614) / ai_choose_help_for_partner (func_800F5770) / ai_choose_at_target_in_two_man_move (func_800F5E5C). (2026-11-13, names5: confirmed: ai_choose_by_place (confirmed) calls it for the AI record's place bit 8 (he on the apron, the target in the ring)).
func_800F356C.name: ai_choose_on_apron_target_in_ring

func_800F3D70.about: ai_choose_on_apron_target_in_ring calls it in a tag match (the AI record +0x80 & 0x20) once the special choosers set nothing. A man outside the legal pair who may act now (non_legal_man_free_to_act (func_80138B14) 1: a tag match, not rule 0x40, not taking part (+0xE9 bit 4), with a partner, and +0x96 & 0xC0 or a legal man off the ring and apron or another such man already in): plan 33 when the target (or the man taking part, *0x8016B720) is in the ring, 33 / 35 by quadrant when he is on the floor. Otherwise, on the skill roll: a third man running (state 3) at him and facing him -> plan 7 (defend briefly; 80%, 40% for his own partner +0x0C); off his own corner (ai_off_own_corner) -> plan 60; the target lying / rising (situations 15, 16, 19) or far -> plan 49 on a personality roll unless used lately (count_recent_states, func_800F0E78), else the table 0x80145484 (plan 32); near, with the target after him: his strike (situation 8) or grapple (11) -> plan 7 on a roll; near and the target not in a state step (+0x80 bit 0): plan 6 (strike) unless his +0x80 & 4, else plan 1 (grapple) unless +0x80 & 2. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: non_legal_man_free_to_act first; the man looked at is the target, or *0x8016B720 when the target is taking part; in the ring plan 0x21 (33) unless he is on the apron, on the floor by quadrant_of_vector against the AI record's own quadrant.)
func_800F3D70.name: ai_choose_on_apron_in_tag_match

func_800F4164.about: The CPU's chooser for its man on the floor outside with the target in the ring (AI record +0x82 place bit 0x40) or on the apron (0x80): ai_choose_by_place calls it. Nothing when func_800F6154 or ai_try_special_choosers acted. The target up top (situations 25 / 26) -> ai_react_to_target_up_top. Then, on the skill roll (+0x20) and the distance estimate +0x68 under 0x8014EF38: the target on the apron -> plan 9 (situation 16) or 6 on a roll from 0x80145524, else plan 1 when unarmed; by the target's situation and the personality byte 0x8016B9E0 (0x80145500): 8 (striking) at him -> plans 46 / 47; other rolls -> plans 33 / 34 or the plan table 0x801454E8 (ai_pick_plan_from_table). Farther: the target on the apron in his quadrant -> plan 10; unarmed on a personality roll (0x801454F4 x the moveset factor, and for a tag man only when non_legal_man_free_to_act) -> plan 101; a roll from 0x80145500 -> 33 / 34; unarmed on 0x80145530 -> plan 38; else the plan table 0x801454C8. Failing the skill roll: plan 34. The three count_recent_states tests (states 0xF, 0x6F, 0x9B, mode 1) always give 0. Plans 1 / 6 / 9 / 10 / 33 / 34 / 38 / 46 / 47 / 101 through ai_set_plan. (2026-11-12, names3: rewritten and confirmed from the lifted C++; the old about only said which place bits lead here.)
func_800F4164.name: ai_choose_outside_target_in_ring

func_800F473C.about: The CPU chooser for place bit 0x10 of the AI record +0x82 (both men on the apron; ai_update_estimates sets it from their +0x82). Under rule 0x400 a man with +0x9E & 0x10 takes plan 33; otherwise the special choosers first (ai_try_special_choosers). On the same apron side (+0x60 equal): near (+0x60 reading under 0x8014EF48) a 30% roll gives plan 6 (a strike); a tag man off his own corner walks back (60); then a 30% roll with the personality chance 0x80145548 (by 0x8016B9E0) gives plan 35 or 33 (back through the ropes, unless 33 / 34 or 35 / 36 were among the last 10 plans), else plan 56 (back off) on a 15% roll. Far on the same side, or on different sides, the personality chance gives 35 (33 / 34 not recent) or, with +0x9E & 0x10, 33; else 56 on 15% or 33 when 35 / 36 were not recent. func_800F89D0.name: ai_choose_at_lying_target

func_800F8C04.about: Under ai_choose_at_lying_target: armed -> holds R; SPECIAL lit (+0xEE & 2) -> plan 50 (the taunt that stores it); unless SPECIAL is ready with 150+ left, ai_try_pin first; then by the slot's move kind 0x80187D30 (ai_set_up_slot; nothing for 0) and, when the AI +0x84 is set, plan 19 (pull him up) unless taken: 0x105 / 0x106 ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (func_800F6524) (0x106 only with SPECIAL ready), 0x112 ai_try_attack_on_down_target(2); too far (+0x68 over the reach +0x7C) -> plan 48 (walk up); 0xD1-0xD8 -> plans 73, 74, 78, 79, 75, 76, 80, 81; unless another man already attacks him, 0xEC-0xFA -> ai_set_plan_with_follow_up(110, 0x52-0x55 / 0x60-0x63) (plan 110 with that move; 0xEC for the one Superstar needs the spirit reading +0x3E >= 70). Returns 1 when it set a plan. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: armed sets the AI buttons word 0x10 (R); SPECIAL lit -> plan 0x32 (50); ai_try_pin unless SPECIAL is ready with +special_timer >= 0x96; 0x105 goes to ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (the func_800F6524 above).)
func_800F8C04.name: ai_use_move_kind_on_lying_target

func_800F8F48.about: Under ai_choose_at_lying_target, on the skill roll (AI +0x20): picks a kind 0-3 (40% the remembered one at 0x80162A78 when the target's stamina reading +0x4C >= 100, else 40% 0x8015A6F4; otherwise at random; outside the ring kind 2 is re-rolled). With SPECIAL ready (his +0xEE bit 2): a nearly spent target (spirit reading +0x4E under 10) and kind 1 early in the SPECIAL (+0xB0 under 90) -> plan 23 (ground grapple, 10%) or a ground move (ai_pick_ground_move_on_lying_target, 30%); under 150 a pin (ai_try_pin); 301+ steps left, kind 2 and match_info +0x3C & 0x400 -> plan 65 (turnbuckle dive; 20%, 45% with the move entry +0x24F8 & 0x8000); else plan 19 (ai_plan_19_unless_target_taken). Without: a pin first (ai_try_pin), then kind 0 ai_pick_from_move_list_b (func_800F96CC), 1 a ground move, 2 a dive at the lying man (ai_pick_dive_at_lying_target), 3 plan 19 (pull him up).
func_800F8F48.name: ai_choose_attack_kind_at_lying_target

func_800F9288.about: The CPU's pin choice (ai_choose_at_lying_target and plan 116): pins allowed (0x800A9950 & 0x20; mod/src/gameplay.c), in the ring (or rule 0x4000), both men taking part, the target's spirit reading +0x4E <= 80; with own +0x8C bit 2, plan 116 already, or the stamina reading under 30 and own +0x8C bit 1 it needs ai_ground_move_pins first; then with the target's stamina reading +0x4C under 40, a roll that grows with the match minutes (0x8016B930; doubled when 0x8009FE6C is 1), then the down reading +0x50, the target's +0xBE (>= 30) or the target dazed (46), a roll on +0xBE * 20 + minutes: plan 24 when ai_ground_move_pins, else ai_set_plan_with_follow_up(0x6E, 8). Returns 1 when it acted. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the tests in order (+0x82 & 0x101, in the ring or rule 0x4000, pins rule 0x20, both +0xE9 & 0x10, spirit estimate < 0x51), the forced path when +0x8C & 4, plan 0x74 or stamina < 0x1E with +0x8C & 2, and the minutes roll 0x8016B930 x 100 (x 200 when 0x8009FE6C is 1).)
func_800F9288.name: ai_try_pin

func_800F95A0.about: For a lying target (+0x80 & 8): from where the CPU stands (its heading +0x64 against his facing: at the head or the feet) and how he lies (+0x8A & 1, +0x80 & 0x10) picks one of eight ground positions (0x8014581C) and reads that entry of the CPU's move list (+0x88, 0x24 each) +0x20: with 0x200 (a pinning move) a 50% roll, 100% with 0x8000. Used by ai_try_pin. (2026-11-13, names5: confirmed: ai_try_pin (confirmed) needs it before pinning (plan 24)).
func_800F95A0.name: ai_ground_move_pins

func_800F96CC.about: The CPU picks from slot `slot`'s move list B (0x80189910 + slot x 0x20, its count at 0x8017DBB2 + 12 x slot; ai_split_move_list splits it into the moves usable now and the rest): with usable ones, on a 40% roll (always when there is no other kind) a random usable one; else a random one of the rest. Moves 0xD1, 0xD2, 0xD5, 0xD6 -> plan 22 (ai_plan_22_strike_lying_target), or 48 (ai_plan_48_walk_up_to_target) when the AI record's reach distance +0x7C is under its float +0x68; 0xD3, 0xD4, 0xD7, 0xD8 -> plan 77 (ai_plan_77_81_lift_then_strike); returns 1 when it set a plan, else 0. Caller ai_choose_attack_kind_at_lying_target. (2026-11-12, from the code.)
func_800F96CC.name: ai_pick_from_move_list_b

func_800F9894.about: Called by ai_choose_attack_kind_at_lying_target (func_800F8F48; the lying-target chooser's other branch): unless another man already attacks the target; too far -> plan 48 (walk up); else from move list A (all of it with SPECIAL ready, otherwise its first entries counted up to the ids >= 0xEC) the usable moves (ai_split_move_list, func_800FAFDC); on a 40% roll one at random, looked up in the pairs at 0x8014582C -> ai_set_plan_with_follow_up(110, its value) (plan 110 with that move); otherwise plan 23 (holds A at the lying man: the ground grapple, 70). Returns 1. The CPU move lists: ai_build_move_lists fills six per slot (A 0x80188330 12 entries, B 0x80189910 8, C 0x8017E4F0 4, D 0x801881B0 3, E 0x801869F0 4, F 0x8017E6F0 4; counts at 0x8017DBB0 + 12 * slot); ai_split_move_list (func_800FAFDC) splits a list into the entries usable now and the rest, and the move ids 0x100-0x118 are the turnbuckle / rope / dive moves of pick_turnbuckle_move and try_running_action. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: 0 when ai_target_under_attack_by_other; plan 0x30 (48) when the distance estimate +0x68 is past the reach +0x7C; with SPECIAL ready the whole of list A (count 0x8017DBB0 + 12 x slot).)
func_800F9894.name: ai_pick_ground_move_on_lying_target

func_800F9A70.about: Under ai_choose_at_down_target_far: the target not on the floor outside, from move list C (0x8017E4F0) the usable moves first (50% roll), else the rest: 0x10D -> ai_try_attack_on_down_target(1) (plan 91: the rope dive 115, moveset 0x2000), 0x10E -> (0) (plan 92: the turnbuckle dive 116, 0x4000), 0x112 -> (2), 0x105 -> ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (func_800F6524; the turnbuckle). Returns 1 when one was set. The CPU move lists: ai_build_move_lists fills six per slot (A 0x80188330 12 entries, B 0x80189910 8, C 0x8017E4F0 4, D 0x801881B0 3, E 0x801869F0 4, F 0x8017E6F0 4; counts at 0x8017DBB0 + 12 * slot); ai_split_move_list (func_800FAFDC) splits a list into the entries usable now and the rest, and the move ids 0x100-0x118 are the turnbuckle / rope / dive moves of pick_turnbuckle_move and try_running_action. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the count at 0x8017DBB4 + 12 x slot, ai_split_move_list (the func_800FAFDC above) into the frame, a random usable entry on chance 500; 0x105 goes to ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (the func_800F6524 above).)
func_800F9A70.name: ai_pick_dive_at_lying_target

func_800F9C6C.about: Sets plan 19 (holds R) and returns 1, unless another wrestler is already attacking the CPU's target (ai_target_under_attack_by_other), when it returns 0. (2026-11-12, names4: confirmed from the lifted C++).
func_800F9C6C.name: ai_plan_19_unless_target_taken

func_800F9C9C.about: 1 when a third wrestler (not the CPU, not its target) in play is after the same man (his record +0x08 equals the CPU's) and is in state 10, 97, 98, 113-119 or 121-123: a dive or a strike at a man on the ground (wrestler_state_40_97_98_strike_lying_man, the dive states 113-120; 10 and 121-123 log the top-rope dives). Used so two CPUs don't both go for a downed man.
func_800F9C9C.name: ai_target_under_attack_by_other

func_800F9D70.about: For kind 0 / 1 / 2: when both men are in the ring (the AI record +0x82 & 1), the AI record's situation +0x48 is 15, the target's down time as read (+0x50) is above 60 / 45 / 30 and the CPU's moveset (match_info +0x38) has 0x4000 / 0x2000 / 0x40000, sets plan 92 (presses A) / 91 (holds the stick, presses A and C-down: run) / 67 and returns 1; otherwise 0. The longer the man stays down, the slower the attack the CPU may try (67 is also the corner plan, ai_try_corner_plan).
func_800F9D70.name: ai_try_attack_on_down_target

func_800F9E40.about: ai_choose_by_target_situation (func_800F1EA4) calls it when the target is near and rising (situation 16: state 50; 19: getting up, 49 phases 4-6; 22 / 23: his +0x8C bits 0x20 / 0x40): plans 50, 113, 49, 48 by SPECIAL, the down reading and 19, else ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target (func_800F9FB4) / ai_choose_by_move_kind_at_rising_target (func_800FA26C). Situation codes (the AI record +0x48, the target's; +0x24 his own): ai_situation_code (func_800FCBB0) maps a wrestler's state to them (jump table 0x8014F850); structs.md lists them. (2026-11-13, names5: confirmed: ai_choose_by_target_situation (confirmed) calls it for the target situations 16, 19, 22 and 23 (rising)).
func_800F9E40.name: ai_choose_at_rising_target

func_800F9FB4.about: Under ai_choose_at_rising_target, on the skill roll: picks kind 0 / 1 / 2 (40% from 0x80159624 when the target's stamina reading +0x4C >= 100, else from 0x80159510; otherwise at random; on the floor outside not 2). With SPECIAL ready: plan 65 when 301+ steps are left, kind 2 and match_info +0x3C & 0x200 on a 20% roll (45% with the move list entry +0x2444 & 0x8000); far -> plan 48 (walk up); situation 19 (getting up) -> plan 55; else plan 2 (grapple). Without: kind 0 -> ai_pick_strike_at_rising_target (func_800FA5E0), 1 -> ai_pick_grapple_at_rising_target (func_800FA7C8) (neither converted), 2 -> ai_pick_attack_at_rising_target. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the kind on the 400-in-1000 roll from 0x80159624 (stamina estimate >= 100) or 0x80159510, else random_0_to_999 % 3.)
func_800F9FB4.name: ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target

func_800FA26C.about: The other branch of ai_choose_at_rising_target: armed -> holds R; situation 19 -> plan 55 (48 when far); SPECIAL lit -> plan 50 (taunt); then by the slot's move kind 0x80187D30 (ai_set_up_slot) and the AI +0x84 bits (0x8 / 0x100 / 0x1000 / 0x2000 / 0x4000 / 0x10 / 0x200, set elsewhere): 0x69 -> plan 5, 0x68 -> 4, 0xC0 -> 11, 0xC2 -> 12, 0xC4 -> 13, 0xC6 -> 14, 0x100 / 0x113 / 0x111 / 0x116 -> ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (func_800F6524) / ai_try_corner_plan_on_down_target / ai_try_plan_89, behind him (not_behind_him 0) plan 100 (holds L at the rising man), else plans 1 / 2 (grapple) or 9 (strike); far -> plan 48. The 0xC0-0xC6 kinds match the strike table rows of ai_pick_strike_buttons. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: armed sets the AI buttons word to 0x10 (R) and goes on; situation 0x13 gives 0x37, or 0x30 past 0x8014F2F8.)
func_800FA26C.name: ai_choose_by_move_kind_at_rising_target

func_800FA5E0.about: Kind 0 of ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target (strikes): the target getting up (situation 19) -> plan 55 (wait); far (AI +0x60 over 0x8014F308) on a 60% roll and the personality chance 0x80145864[*0x8016B93C] -> plan 10 (running strike); with the target's stamina reading +0x4C >= 100 a 50/50 of 6 / 9; in the ring on a 25% roll the first of the moveset entries 0xC0-0xC3 (the move list +0x88, +0x20 & 0x8000) -> plans 11-14; else 6 (strike, 10%) or 9 (strike combo); plan 48 (walk up) instead when he is too far for it. Returns 1 when it set a plan (0 for plan 6 near).
func_800FA5E0.name: ai_pick_strike_at_rising_target

func_800FA7C8.about: Kind 1 of ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target (grapples): the target getting up (situation 19) -> plan 55 (wait); with the target's stamina reading +0x4C >= 100 a 50/50 of plan 1 / 2; in the ring on a 25% roll moveset entries 0x69 / 0x6A (the move list +0x88, +0x20 & 0x8000) -> plans 4 / 5 (rope-run attacks); else plan 1 (grapple, 10%) or 2 (grapple with a follow-up), or 48 (walk up) when he is too far (AI +0x60 against 0x8014F320 / 0x8014F328). Returns 1.
func_800FA7C8.name: ai_pick_grapple_at_rising_target

func_800FA920.about: From move list D (0x801881B0) when the target is not on the floor outside, the usable moves first (50% roll), else the rest: 0x100 -> ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (func_800F6524; the turnbuckle), 0x111 -> ai_try_corner_plan_on_down_target (plan 67), 0x116 -> ai_try_plan_89 (plan 89: the run off the ropes at the rising man; the springboard 120 with moveset 0x80000). Called by ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target and ai_choose_at_down_target_far. The CPU move lists: ai_build_move_lists fills six per slot (A 0x80188330 12 entries, B 0x80189910 8, C 0x8017E4F0 4, D 0x801881B0 3, E 0x801869F0 4, F 0x8017E6F0 4; counts at 0x8017DBB0 + 12 * slot); ai_split_move_list (func_800FAFDC) splits a list into the entries usable now and the rest, and the move ids 0x100-0x118 are the turnbuckle / rope / dive moves of pick_turnbuckle_move and try_running_action. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: nothing with the target on the floor (+0x82 & 4) or an empty list (0x8017DBB6 + 12 x slot); ai_split_move_list of list D, a random usable entry on chance 500.)
func_800FA920.name: ai_pick_attack_at_rising_target

func_800FAB0C.about: Sets plan 67 and returns 1 when the AI record's +0x82 & 9 (both in the ring, or the CPU on the other side of the ropes with the target in the ring), its situation +0x48 is 16, the target's down time as read (+0x50) is at least 31, and either the CPU has SPECIAL! (+0xEE & 4) with moveset +0x3C & 0x800 or the moveset has +0x38 & 0x20000; otherwise 0. Plan 67 reads as the turnbuckle attack (ai_try_corner_plan).
func_800FAB0C.name: ai_try_corner_plan_on_down_target

func_800FABB4.about: ai_choose_in_ring_target_outside, the target lying outside (situation 15): with him on the floor (+0x82 & 4), from move list E (0x801869F0), the usable moves first (40% roll), else the rest: 0x109 -> ai_try_dive_over_ropes(1) (plan 62), 0x10A -> (0) (plan 63), 0x10C -> plan 37, 0x108 -> ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (func_800F6524). Returns 1 when one was set. The CPU move lists: ai_build_move_lists fills six per slot (A 0x80188330 12 entries, B 0x80189910 8, C 0x8017E4F0 4, D 0x801881B0 3, E 0x801869F0 4, F 0x8017E6F0 4; counts at 0x8017DBB0 + 12 * slot); ai_split_move_list (func_800FAFDC) splits a list into the entries usable now and the rest, and the move ids 0x100-0x118 are the turnbuckle / rope / dive moves of pick_turnbuckle_move and try_running_action. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the count at 0x8017DBB8 + 12 x slot, ai_split_move_list of list E, a random usable entry on chance 400.)
func_800FABB4.name: ai_pick_dive_at_lying_target_outside

func_800FADC8.about: ai_choose_in_ring_target_outside, the target rising / getting up outside (situations 16, 19; also after the lying case): as ai_pick_dive_at_lying_target_outside from move list F (0x8017E6F0) with a 50% roll and 0x107 for the ai_try_turnbuckle_dive_plan (func_800F6524) case: 0x109 -> plan 62, 0x10A -> plan 63, 0x10C -> plan 37. The CPU move lists: ai_build_move_lists fills six per slot (A 0x80188330 12 entries, B 0x80189910 8, C 0x8017E4F0 4, D 0x801881B0 3, E 0x801869F0 4, F 0x8017E6F0 4; counts at 0x8017DBB0 + 12 * slot); ai_split_move_list (func_800FAFDC) splits a list into the entries usable now and the rest, and the move ids 0x100-0x118 are the turnbuckle / rope / dive moves of pick_turnbuckle_move and try_running_action. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: with the target on the floor (+0x82 & 4), the count at 0x8017DBBA + 12 x slot, ai_split_move_list of list F, a random usable entry on chance 500.)
func_800FADC8.name: ai_pick_dive_at_rising_target_outside

func_800FAFDC.about: Splits a CPU move list (`count` 4-byte entries {s16 move, u8 flags}) into the moves usable now (flags bit 0) and the rest, as s32 lists; returns how many are usable. Used by the move-list pickers (ai_pick_ground_move_on_lying_target, ai_pick_dive_at_lying_target, ...).
func_800FAFDC.name: ai_split_move_list

func_800FB038.about: Fills the slot's six CPU move lists (A 0x80188330 12 x 4 bytes, B 0x80189910, C 0x8017E4F0, D 0x801881B0, E 0x801869F0, F 0x8017E6F0; exe lifted_layout.h names them "CPU move list A-F (func_800FB038)") with ai_collect_move_list (func_800FB184) from the tables 0x80145FB0 / 0x80146010 / 0x80146050 / 0x80146070 / 0x80146088 / 0x801460A8, and stores the six counts at 0x8017DBB0 + slot * 12. Called by ai_set_up_slot (the CPU set-up). (2026-11-13, names5: confirmed: six ai_collect_move_list calls (confirmed), each into one of the slot's lists, its count stored beside it).
func_800FB038.name: ai_build_move_lists

func_800FB184.about: Builds one of the slot's CPU move lists from `table` (`count` 8-byte rows {s32 moveset mask, s32 move}): a row with mask 0, or whose mask the moveset (+0x1D4 +0x38) has, gives {s16 move, u8 usable} with usable = the slot's move table entry (0x805507C0 + 0x4D10 x slot + 0x24 x move) +0x20 bit 15; -1 first when none. Returns the count. Called by ai_build_move_lists.
func_800FB184.name: ai_collect_move_list

func_800FB2A4.about: Clears the slot's favoured move kind 0x80187D30[slot] when its row in 0x80145870 (15 rows {kind, mask, which}) asks for a moveset bit the man lacks (+0x1D4 +0x3C when which is 1, else +0x38). Called by ai_set_up_slot.
func_800FB2A4.name: ai_check_move_kind_in_moveset

func_800FB35C.about: Sets the slot's AI record +0x84 (the choice bits the choosers test) from its favoured move kind 0x80187D30[slot]: the kind is grouped (5-0x14 -> 0, 0x19-0x41 -> 1, 0x46 -> 2, 0x49-0x4C -> 3, 0x4D-0x50 -> 4, 0x51 -> 5, ... up to 0x19) and the group indexes the u16 table 0x80145924; no group -> 0. Called by ai_set_up_slot. So +0x84 comes from the move kind.
func_800FB35C.name: ai_choice_bits_from_move_kind

func_800FB4C0.about: Whether the CPU's legal man should tag his partner: ai_choose_in_ring sets plan 61 (presses C-up, the tag) when it returns 1. Needs `wrestler` in the ring (+0x82 & 1) and taking part (+0xE9 & 0x10), a tag match (0x80097EC0 & 0x2000) without rule 0x40, and the partner (*0x8016B92C, the record his +0x0C names) with +0xF2 & 0x18; then either the gap between the CPU's man's +0xDE and `wrestler`'s stamina +0xAA is 51 or more (a 30% roll), or his time as legal man (+0xDC) is 2701 or more with the partner present (Superstar not -1) on the apron (a 30% roll); then his own spirit reading +0x3E under 90 and the target not lying (or half the time), and the partner's quadrant (body_point_ring_quadrant, func_800FD128) on his team's side. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++; the old about read the first test as the partner's stamina lead, but both values are the CPU man's own.)
func_800FB4C0.name: ai_should_tag_partner

func_800FB64C.about: The CPU chooser for place bit 0x2000 of the AI record +0x82 (he in the ring, the target on the cage wall, his +0x82 & 0x400; ai_update_estimates sets it). With SPECIAL lit (+0xEE & 2) and the target dazed on the wall (198) it taunts to store it (plan 50). Far (+0x60 over 0x8014F778), on the skill roll: SPECIAL ready (+0xEE & 4) and the target not going over the top (196) -> plan 121 (run at the cage, C-up), else 122 (C-right) or 10 (50%); no roll -> 48 (walk up). Near, on the skill roll: the target diving off the wall (207) -> on the difficulty chance 0x80145984 plan 131 (guard) or a pick from the table 0x80145958; the target going over the top (196) -> 123 (to the cage wall, after him); close (+0x90 under 0x8014F788): the target striking from the wall (204) -> 7 or 47 (timed R) on rolls; else SPECIAL ready -> 128 (climb onto the cage on his side, unless plan 33 was among the last 5); else the chance 0x8014596C (by 0x80159980) -> 1 (grapple) or 6 (strike) when near; otherwise 128 or 123 by his spirit reading (+0x3E, 51) and the chance 0x80145978 (+500 with SPECIAL ready). (2026-11-12, names4: rewritten from the lifted C++; the old about named only the place bit.)
func_800FB64C.name: ai_choose_target_on_cage_wall

func_800FBA08.about: The CPU chooser for place bit 0x4000 of the AI record +0x82 (he on the cage wall, the target in the ring; ai_update_estimates sets it). At the top of the wall (nearest_wall_kind_800_flag_8) plan 129 (over onto the cage top); otherwise, on the skill roll with the target near: a target not down (+0x80 & 5) and not in situations 15-20, close (+0x90 under 0x8014F7A0) and on the chance 0x801459A0 x 0x801459AC, plan 132 (strike from the cage wall); a target climbing after him (200) very near with his spirit reading +0x3E under 10 gets A held on a skill roll; else plan 124 (up the wall). (2026-11-12, names4: rewritten from the lifted C++; the old about named only the place bit.)
func_800FBA08.name: ai_choose_on_cage_wall_target_in_ring

func_800FBBC0.about: The CPU chooser for place bit 0x8000 of the AI record +0x82 (both men on the cage wall; ai_update_estimates sets it). On the skill roll: the target striking from the wall (204) near -> plan 7 on the difficulty chance 0x801459CC; otherwise a chance 0x801459C0 x 0x801459D4 (+300 with the target going over the top, 196, or dazed, 198, and his spirit reading 51 or more; -150 under 20): on the same side (+0x60) and near, plan 132 (strike) when very close, else by the height gap +0x90: 126, 124 (up) or 125 (down, when he is not below the target), only with his spirit reading +0x3E outside 20-80; on different sides, below the target and not at 196, plan 125 (down) or 130 (C-up with down, at the wall's foot: nearest_wall_kind_400_flag_4). Otherwise plan 129 at the top of the wall (nearest_wall_kind_800_flag_8) or 124 (up). (2026-11-12, names4: rewritten from the lifted C++; the old about named only the place bit.)
func_800FBBC0.name: ai_choose_both_on_cage_wall

func_800FBE54.about: 1 when his nearest wall (+0x348) has kind bit 0x800 (+0x26) and flag bit 3 (+0x28); else 0. Used by the cage-wall choosers (ai_choose_on_cage_wall_target_in_ring, ai_choose_both_on_cage_wall). Read from the code (second review).
func_800FBE54.name: nearest_wall_kind_800_flag_8

func_800FBE84.about: 1 when his nearest wall (+0x348) has kind bit 0x400 (+0x26) and flag bit 2 (+0x28); else 0. Used by ai_choose_both_on_cage_wall. Read from the code (second review).

Last, his +0x8C bit 0x20 makes it 0x16 (22) and bit 0x40 0x17 (23), as fields.json's flags_8c says. (2026-11-12, from the code; fields.json already named it the situation code.)

func_800FCEB4.about: Sets the CPU's current plan: in the AI record of the slot being decided (*0x8015A6F0, mod/src/gameplay.c NM_AI_CUR) +0x00 = `plan`, +0x04 / +0x08 = 0, +0x56 = his target's state at the time (*0x80159618 -> +0x14), and +0x80's low bits to 1 (a new plan). Each plan has a step in the table at 0x80145A10 (the ai_plan_N functions). Called from about 176 places.
func_800FCEB4.name: ai_set_plan

func_800FCEFC.about: The same code as ai_set_plan (the AI record's plan, +0x04 / +0x08 cleared, +0x56 his target's state, +0x80 marked): a second copy, called from ai_choose_running_attack_plan.
func_800FCEFC.name: ai_set_plan_2

func_800FCF44.about: ai_set_plan, then marks the CPU wrestler's own record (*0x8016B8E8, +0x88 bit 0) as changed this step.
func_800FCF44.name: ai_set_plan_and_mark

func_800FCF74.about: ai_set_plan, unless the CPU already has that plan (the AI record's +0x00).
func_800FCF74.name: ai_set_plan_if_new

func_800FCFA4.about: The CPU picks a plan at random from a weighted table: a random 0-999 (random_0_to_999), then the table's 6-byte rows (s16 threshold, s16 plan, ...; ended by -1) are walked until one's threshold is at least that number, and that row's plan is set (ai_set_plan).
func_800FCFA4.name: ai_pick_plan_from_table

func_800FD040.about: When the CPU has no plan (the AI record's +0x00 is 0), picks one at random from a weighted table of 6-byte rows (s16 threshold, s16 plan, ..., byte +5 the choice bits; ended by -1) against random_0_to_999 (the first row whose threshold is not below it), as ai_pick_plan_from_table does: ai_set_plan(row plan), then the AI record's +0x80 low two bits set to the row's +5. Called by the AI's step (func_800F03F0). Read from the code.
func_800FD040.name: ai_pick_plan_if_idle

func_800FD0F0.about: Like ai_set_plan but keeps the follow-up: the AI record +0x00 = `plan`, +0x86 = `follow_up` (plan 110 takes the ground-move plan 82-85 / 96-99 from it), +0x04 / +0x08 = 0, +0x56 = the target's state, +0x80 low two bits cleared. Callers: ai_use_move_kind_on_lying_target, ai_try_pin, ai_pick_ground_move_on_lying_target.
func_800FD0F0.name: ai_set_plan_with_follow_up

func_800FD128.about: The ring quadrant 0-3 of his body point (+0x120 x, +0x128 z): x > 0: 0 with z > 0, else 1; x <= 0: 3 with z > 0, else 2 -- the corner index of the points 0x8014D1A8. func_800F03F0 puts it in the AI record +0x40 / +0x52.
func_800FD128.name: body_point_ring_quadrant

func_800FD188.about: The CPU's readings of the match before it decides (called by its step, func_800F03F0): noisy copies (ai_noisy_estimate) of its own stamina (record +0xAA) into the AI record +0x3C, the target's stamina into +0x4C, its own spirit (+0xAE) into +0x3E, the target's spirit into +0x4E, the AI record's +0x68 into +0x60 and +0x90 into itself, and its record's five floats +0x2C4.. into +0x28..; the target's down timer (+0xB4) into +0x50 while the target is in state 24 (in the corner), 49, 50 or 52 (60 for 46, else 0). Then +0x82 gets one bit for where the two men are, from their place bits (record +0x82 & 1 / 2 / 4 / 0x400): both & 1 -> 1, he & 1 with the target & 0x400 -> 0x2000, & 2 -> 2, else 4; he & 2: target & 1 -> 8, & 2 -> 0x10, else 0x20; he & 4: 0x40 / 0x80; he & 0x400: 0x4000 / 0x8000; otherwise 0x100. +0x80 bit 4: SPECIAL! (his +0xEE & 4) when his moveset (match_info +0x34) has 0x2000, or the target's does; bit 5: a tag match (0x80097EC0 & 0x2000) not in the Rumble (+0xE9 & 0x10) and without 0x800A9950 & 0x40; bit 6: 0x80097EC0 & 0x4000 with 0x800A9950 & 0x400.
func_800FD188.name: ai_update_estimates

func_800FD5FC.about: How far `point` is from rope side `side` (0: the line z = 0x8014FC10, 1: x = that, 2 / 3 the negative sides by 0x8014FC18), measured inward; 230 for another side. Used by ai_room_to_run_from_ropes, ai_rope_run_lines_up, plan 4 / 5, plans 13 / 14 and more.
func_800FD5FC.name: distance_to_rope_side

func_800FD684.about: Returns 230.0 (the value distance_to_rope_side gives for no side). No caller found (no jal in RecompiledFuncs). Read from the code (second review).
func_800FD684.name: ai_constant_230

func_800FD68C.about: Does nothing. No caller found (no jal in RecompiledFuncs). Read from the code (second review).
func_800FD68C.name: ai_empty_step

func_800FD694.about: 1 when `him` is not turned away from `me`: the way from `me` to `him` (their body points at +0x120, angle_to) differs from `him`'s facing (+0x10C) by a quarter turn (0x400) or more. 0 means `me` is behind him. Used by the CPU's decisions.
func_800FD694.name: not_behind_him

func_800FD6DC.about: A value as the CPU perceives it: `value` plus a random error (random_0_to_999) whose size is value * (a constant less the AI record's +0x20 skill chance times another), capped at value * `spread`, centred on the value and never below 0. ai_update_estimates reads the stamina, spirit and distances through it, so a better CPU (a higher +0x20) misjudges less.
func_800FD6DC.name: ai_noisy_estimate

func_800FD7C0.about: Picks a row from a weighted table at random: a random 0-999 (random_0_to_999), then the table's 8-byte rows (s32 threshold first, ended by -1) are walked until one's threshold is at least that number, and that row's value is returned (0 when the table runs out). Like ai_pick_plan_from_table, without setting the plan. Read from the code (second review).
func_800FD7C0.name: ai_pick_from_weighted_table

func_800FD828.about: ai_choose_by_place calls it in a ring venue for a man with +0xE9 bit 1 when no other man in play has +0xE9 bit 1 and +0xF1 bit 1 (the pair ai_marked_man_check tests): standing (1) with +0xE9 bit 0 and the target not his +0x0C man and far (+0x68 over 0x8014FC38) -> faces his +0x0C man again (+0x08 = +0x0C); on the floor (+0x82 & 4) with his z (0x8015967C) under 0x8014FC40 -> plan 71 (walk down until z), for slot 2 plan 72 by his quadrant +0x42. Reading: a non-competing second (a manager-like role) staying near his man; not settled.
func_800FD828.name: ai_choose_for_second_man

func_800FD934.about: The control-pad bits for the CPU to press toward its target: direction_to gives the direction 0-7 from its own position copy (0x80159674) to the target's (0x8016B9C0), and the table at 0x8014D258 turns it into the pad bits {0x0800 up, 0x0900 up-right, 0x0100 right, 0x0500 down-right, 0x0400 down, 0x0600 down-left, 0x0200 left, 0x0A00 up-left} (the N64's U / D / L / R_JPAD bits). 11 callers, the plans that walk or run at him. (2026-11-12: renamed from ai_direction_code_to_target; the table read from the ROM, ovl_e loaded at 0x800D9960 from ROM 0x144BE0.)
func_800FD934.name: ai_dpad_toward_target

func_800FD970.about: The CPU's step for plan 0, having no plan: it only calls ai_choose_by_place (func_800F0EF0), which chooses the next plan (setting it with ai_set_plan). Called through the plan table at 0x80145A10 by the AI (func_800F03F0).
func_800FD970.name: ai_plan_0_choose

func_800FD98C.about: Step 0 holds A (grapple, +0x0C = 0x8000). Step 1 waits while his own situation is 11 (his grab under way, state 80); still standing (own situation 1) with the target near (+0x60 under 0x8014FC48) and on the skill roll (+0x20) it answers the target: striking (8) -> plan 46 (the R guard), grappling (11) -> plan 21 (the L stance, 75%) or 43 (the timed grapple back); otherwise, or in any other situation, back to plan 0. The grapple row (1, with 2) of nearly every chooser table, beside the strike rows 6 / 9. Called through the plan table 0x80145A10 by the CPU step func_800F03F0 while the AI record (*0x8015A6F0) +0x00 is the plan; +0x24 is his own situation code, +0x48 the target's (structs.md). Handed out by: ai_choose_in_ring, ai_choose_at_target_near, ai_choose_on_apron_in_tag_match, ai_choose_outside_target_in_ring, ai_choose_help_for_partner (func_800F5770), ai_choose_at_target_in_corner, ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target, ai_choose_by_move_kind_at_rising_target, ai_choose_target_on_cage_wall, ai_choose_away_from_ring, ai_plan_2_grapple_with_follow_up, ai_plan_6_strike, ai_plan_9_strike_combo, ai_plan_32_wait_and_watch (func_801028F0), ai_plan_41, ai_plan_43, ai_plan_57_58, func_8010E26C. (2026-11-12, names4: about corrected from the lifted C++: the old reading had the answers given once he was in the grapple; they are given while he is still standing).
func_800FD98C.name: ai_plan_1_grapple

func_800FDA7C.about: Step 0: for a target rising (situation 16) or in the corner (20) it may switch first to an L plan with a follow-up stored in +0x86 (the plan itself): in the corner plan 94 with SPECIAL ready (+0xEE bit 2) and the moveset bits +0x3C & 0x600000 matching the target's +0x8A bit 0, or without SPECIAL on a 15% roll when the slot byte 0x80188930 + slot is 0; rising, with the place bits 0x101, SPECIAL ready and not behind him (not_behind_him), plan 100 when the moveset +0x3C has bit 0 but not bit 1; with place bit 8 and behind him, plan 0. Step 1 clears +0x86 and holds A (grapple). Step 2: his own man in 80 (the grapple attempt) keeps A held; back to standing (1) hands over to plan 1 at its step 1; anything else ends the plan (0). Called through the plan table 0x80145A10 by the CPU step func_800F03F0 while the AI record (*0x8015A6F0) +0x00 is the plan; +0x24 is his own situation code, +0x48 the target's (structs.md). Handed out by: ai_choose_in_ring, ai_choose_at_target_near, ai_choose_on_apron_target_in_ring, ai_choose_at_target_in_corner, ai_choose_attack_kind_at_rising_target, ai_choose_by_move_kind_at_rising_target, ai_choose_away_from_ring, ai_choose_with_special_ready_a, ai_choose_with_special_ready_b, ai_choose_with_special_ready_c. (2026-11-12, names4: about corrected from the lifted C++: the state tested in step 2 is his own man's (*0x8016B8E8), not the target's).
func_800FDA7C.name: ai_plan_2_grapple_with_follow_up

func_800FDCD8.about: Step 0 holds C-down (run, +0x0C = 4) when the target is not lying (situation 15) and the place bits +0x82 & 0x101 are set, else plan 0. Step 1: rebounding (own situation 4) hands over to plan 119 (steer the run); 5 / 11 wait; running (2) at phase 2 of the run: near (+0x60 under 0x8014FC50) on the skill roll L (0x20) against a target striking (8) or grappling (11); within reach (+0x68 under 0x8014FC58) A (0x8000) at a standing target, or at one down (+0x80 & 3) or lying (15) on the skill roll R (20%) / L (40%), else plan 119; any other situation ends the plan. Only ai_choose_running_attack_plan hands it out. Called through the plan table 0x80145A10 by the CPU step func_800F03F0 while the AI record (*0x8015A6F0) +0x00 is the plan; +0x24 is his own situation code, +0x48 the target's (structs.md). Handed out by: ai_choose_running_attack_plan. (2026-11-12, names4: about corrected from the lifted C++: L (not R / L) is the answer to a strike or grapple, and R / L are for a man down).
func_800FDCD8.name: ai_plan_3_run_attack

func_800FDEB8.about: ai_choose_by_move_kind_at_rising_target gives 4 / 5 for the move kinds 0x68 / 0x69 (running moves: 0x68 is plan 109 in the running-attack table): positions himself by the angle from the target and the rope distances (distance_to_rope_side, func_800FD5FC), stores the stick code in +0x10, runs and holds A at the target; plans 100 / 119 on the way. Called through the plan table 0x80145A10 by the CPU step func_800F03F0 while the AI record (*0x8015A6F0) +0x00 is the plan; +0x24 is his own situation code, +0x48 the target's (structs.md). Handed out by: ai_choose_by_move_kind_at_rising_target. (2026-11-12, names4: confirmed from the lifted C++: moveset +0x38 & 0x01800000 and the target not lying; angle_quadrant of the angle from the target and distance_to_rope_side pick the side (sticks 0x80145C54 / 0x80145C5C against his +0x98 bits, counts 15 / 45); the run with A at the target, L near on the skill roll against a strike / grapple, R / L at a man down; plans 100 / 119).
func_800FDEB8.name: ai_plan_4_5_rope_run_attack

func_800FE508.about: Holds B, or the strike ai_pick_strike_buttons gives (kind by the target's situation, 20 in the corner); R instead when armed with the DQ rule; step 1 waits for his own situation 8 (striking; else plan 0); once he stands again (1): a target getting up (17 / 18) far off with the place bits 0x103 may get a running attack (ai_choose_running_attack_plan) on the skill roll; near, on the skill roll and a 25% roll, the strike again (step 0); otherwise, unarmed, on the skill roll: R (the guard) against a strike (8), A or L (50%) against a grapple (11), plan 1 (grapple) at a target standing (1) or in situation 14, else plan 0. The strike row (6, with 9) of the chooser tables. Called through the plan table 0x80145A10 by the CPU step func_800F03F0 while the AI record (*0x8015A6F0) +0x00 is the plan; +0x24 is his own situation code, +0x48 the target's (structs.md). Handed out by: ai_choose_by_target_situation (func_800F1EA4), ai_choose_at_target_near, ai_choose_on_apron_in_tag_match, ai_choose_outside_target_in_ring, ai_choose_both_on_apron, ai_choose_help_for_partner (func_800F5770), ai_pick_strike_at_rising_target (func_800FA5E0), ai_choose_target_on_cage_wall, ai_plan_95_guard_armed_target. (2026-11-12, names4: about corrected from the lifted C++ (the after-strike step); the first steps confirmed: B (0x4000) with the place bits +0x82 & 0xE0FE or armed without rule 0x2000, R when armed with it, else ai_pick_strike_buttons(1, kind 0, or 4 / 5 in the corner by the target's +0xF6 bit 3)).
func_800FE508.name: ai_plan_6_strike

func_800FE7C8.about: Picks a strike for the strike plans (ai_plan_6, 9, 10, 51, 139): by `kind` a table of 8-byte rows {s32 move kind, u16 buttons, s8 counter index} -- 0 0x80145C74 (kinds 0xAC-0xAF), 1 0x80145C94 (0xBA-0xBE), 2 0x80145CAC (0xC0, 0xC2), 3 0x80145CBC (0xC0-0xC6), 4 0x80145CDC / 5 0x80145CEC (0xB0-0xB3), 6 0x80145CFC (0xC8, 0xCA), 7 0x80145D0C (0xCC); the buttons are B 0x4000, B with the stick 0x4F00 or A+B 0xC000. With the per-slot byte 0x80188930 set the row matching the slot's move kind 0x80187D30, else on a 30% roll one marked 0x8000 in the move list +0x88, else random; `flags` & 2 takes the least used (the AI +0x8C counters, s16 at +4). Returns the buttons; out_counter = the counter index. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the row counts are 4, 3, 2, 4, 2, 2, 2, 1 by kind; the slot's byte is 0x80188930 by the target's slot (*0x8016B8E8); with neither it nor `flags` & 1 the first row is taken, and the 30% roll / random pick only run with one of them.)
func_800FE7C8.name: ai_pick_strike_buttons

func_800FEA94.about: The CPU's step for plan 7: holds R (defend) for a few steps -- a random 0, 4, 8 or 12 more (random_0_to_999 & 0xC, counted down in the AI record's +0x18) -- then goes back to plan 0 to choose again. Called through the plan table at 0x80145A10 by the AI (func_800F03F0).
func_800FEA94.name: ai_plan_7_defend_briefly

func_800FEB14.about: At a lying target (situation 15; anything else ends it): step 0 clears +0x86 and walks at him (ai_dpad_toward_target) until within reach (+0x68 under +0x7C); step 1 ends plan 8 itself (plan 0) unless the place bits have bit 0 or rule 0x4000 is set (0x800A9950), when it jumps to step 4, which holds L (0x20) once and ends. Steps 2 and 3 (wait for his own situation 53, the lift, then 47, 1 or 53) are reached only if the step is set to 2 from outside. No setter found in the code. Called through the plan table 0x80145A10 by the CPU step func_800F03F0 while the AI record (*0x8015A6F0) +0x00 is the plan; +0x24 is his own situation code, +0x48 the target's (structs.md). func_80112074.about:
A landed move's effect on `victim` from `attacker`, read from the move as copied into the victim's record (+0x314 on; copy_move_to_other). The damage is the sum of three parts, each kept at least 0: (body_part_health(attacker, part +0x32B) + c) x scale x c' (doubles at 0x80150920 / 0x80150928); (the attacker's match_info byte +0xA + that part - the victim's match_info byte +0xF + part +0x32C) x scale / 10; and, when scale isn't 0, (attacker's spirit - victim's spirit) / 20. scale is the copy's +0x326, or +0x33B when +0x33C is set and equals +0x31E (then +0x8C bit 0x4000 is set; it is cleared first). While the attacker's SPECIAL is ready (+0xEE & 4) the damage is multiplied by the double at 0x80150930.
Then add_to_stamina(victim, -damage, mode) and tally_move_hit(victim, damage, mode), mode 1 in states 0x45 / 0x49 / 0x4B, 2 when +0x340 has 0x08000000, else 0; without that bit his stamina cap +0xAC also loses damage / 4 (at least 1 when scale isn't 0), kept at 64 or more. Each of the five body parts i loses the copy's byte +0x332 + i (in state 0x49 plus the float at 0x801461C0 + 12 x attacker's match_info +0x16 + 4 x victim's, when that byte isn't 0; add_to_body_part_health); when part +0x32C isn't 4 and is now his lowest of the four (from 50 down), +0xE7 = that part (the hurt part pick_walk_file and pick_stand_file use). Last award_move_spirit(attacker, victim, victim), update_spirit_meter(victim, 3), and +0xEE bit 0x10 on both men. Leaves the damage in v0. 21 callers (the move states, on_animation_ending). (Confirmed and spelled out 2026-11-12 from the code; the doubles' values weren't read.)
func_80112074.name: apply_move_damage

func_8011241C.about: How long a man stays down (the callers store it in his +0xB4, the down timer): by `kind` (0 a knockdown, 2 the corner, 5 the hold 128, 7 seated in the corner, more): kind 0 = 180 + 3 * his +0xBE (a count that grows with punishment; reset to 180 when +0x8C & 0x800) - (stamina +0xAA + spirit +0xAE) / 2 - 80 * his +0xCE (less 2 when the other man's +0x8C & 4), scaled down at ringside in a tag match and on the apron (0x80150968 / 0x80150970); 0 when +0xEE & 4 (DANGER-type flag). Called by 15 handlers (lying, the corner, the holds). (2026-11-14, fablenames2 continuation: locals named from the lines that define and use them, not from a whole reading. The result is built per `kind` from terms such as 180 + 3 x punishment count, half of stamina + spirit, 80 x the recovery level, a row of the table 0x801461E4 by punishment count, the move tally's average - 15, and 100 (or 180) less half his spirit and a quarter of his stamina; negative results are clamped to 0 (the complement's sign as a mask). `a3_in` is the register a3 as the caller left it, the starting value when no kind sets one.)
func_8011241C.name: compute_down_time

Most kinds look the chance up in a threshold table (pairs of s16 limit / chance or f32 chance at 0x801461F4, 0x8014620C, 0x80146224, 0x8014624C, 0x80146264, 0x8014628C, 0x801462F0, 0x80146304) by the first row whose limit is above his spirit, stamina or down timer; one kind is 500 - 10 x the other man's lead in spirit; one uses the weight-class gap; the ladder kind adds a per-rung bonus (0x8014631C) to the difference of spirit / 5.)

func_80112FE0.about: Wrestler state 66's step: covering a lying man for a pin: walks to a spot by his side (side_of_man, rotate_offset_xz, walk_toward_spot), turns, plays the cover file (0x2FE0 + 10 x the side, or 0x3046 + 2 x side), then 68 (the pin count, which try_tag_partner_save reads as the pin) with the man in 67 / 69. The state machine (run_wrestler_state_step, func_800E5890) calls it once a step through the table at 0x80144CF0 while the wrestler's record +0x14 is 66, with the step context 0x80159080 (+0x00 his slot, +0x2C his record, +0x30 his target's record); phases are his record +0x18. func_8011D100.about:
The spirit meter's routine for `wrestler`, by `mode` (his spirit +0xAE, the meter bits +0xEE: 1 DANGER, 2 SPECIAL lit, 4 SPECIAL ready; the timer +0xB0); returns 1 only from mode 5:
0: timer = 120.
1 (each step; nothing with a meter bit set or on the cage wall): every 120 steps his spirit drifts -- by -8 (kept at 1) when he is off the ring and apron (+0x82 & 3) while his target (+0x08) is on one, else toward 50 (51 and up -1, 31-49 +2, 30 and below +3).
2 (each step with a meter bit set): counts the timer down; when it runs out the spirit is set by the bit (DANGER 40, SPECIAL lit 70, SPECIAL ready 60), and then -- or at once while SPECIAL is lit with spirit under 100 -- the timer goes back to 120 and the meter bits are cleared.
3 (apply_move_damage, on the man hit): with SPECIAL lit or ready the timer loses 60.
4: DANGER: timer 300, spirit 0, bits 1.
5: with SPECIAL lit, makes it ready: timer 600, bits 4, returns 1.
7: spirit 50 and the meter ended (timer 120, bits 0). Other modes do nothing.

Used by the running state's helpers (choose_run_heading, try_running_through_ropes).

func_8012C928.about: Keeps a wrestler out of the arena's walls: func_8012CB8C(wrestler, -, -, softness, -, -, -, wall_mask, mode, apply). It tests his position against the walls of the zone he is in (his record +0x350 or his area bits +0x82), pushes him out along the deepest wall's normal (and a second wall's at a corner) by the depth divided by `softness`, only along the axes `wall_mask` allows (0 all; 0x300 across x, 0xC00 across z), and notes the nearest walls in +0x348 / +0x34C. The mover returns the kinds of wall hit; this wrapper drops it. About 80 callers, e.g. with softness 2.0.
func_8012C928.name: push_out_of_walls

func_8012C974.about: push_out_of_walls for a wrestler with two others carried along by the same push (`carry_a`, `carry_b`, e.g. the man in his grip), every wall kind allowed: func_8012CB8C(wrestler, carry_a, carry_b, softness, -, -, -, 0, mode, 1).
func_8012C974.name: push_out_of_walls_carrying

func_8012C9B0.about: push_out_of_walls_carrying, with the others carried only until the wrestler's animation frame (+0xA4) passes the frame in his current file's record (his +0x2E8 record's +0x11), and only along the axes `wall_mask` allows. Returns the kinds of wall hit (0x300 across x, 0xC00 across z).

func_8012CA34.about: push_out_of_walls for a wrestler carrying `carry_a`, also shifting the three vectors at `points3` by the same push. Returns the kinds of wall hit.

func_8012CA7C.about: Keeps a wrestler out of the arena's walls, carrying the men he is linked with in a move: looks his state (+0x14) up in the table at 0x8014D70C (20-byte rows: +0 his state, +2 the state `other` must be in, +4 the state `third_man` must be in, +8 the softness when carrying, +0xC the mode, +0x10 the softness alone; the table ends with -1). Not listed: returns 0. Listed: each of `other` and `third_man` is kept only when his state is the row's; with either kept, push_out_of_walls_carrying_until_frame(wrestler, other, third_man, carry softness, `wall_mask`, mode), else push_out_of_walls(wrestler, softness, `wall_mask`, mode); returns the kinds of wall hit (& 0xFFFF). 38 callers, the paired move states (85 / 86, 91 / 92, 100 / 101 and more). (2026-11-12: renamed from keep_pair_together, a guess at what the row did: the code shows it is the wall push of push_out_of_walls with the partners carried.)

func_8012D918.about:
Sets the match type's set-up bits (0x800A957C, cleared first; 0x200 is the Royal Rumble) and the count 0x800A9582 (2 for the 0x851C rows, 4 for 0x851D, 3 for 0x851E / 0x851F: read as the men in the match) from the label (+0x60) of the menu row under the cursor (*0x80158BFC + 0x88 x *0x80158BEC), by the menu context (menu_context):
1 (Multi Play): 0x8522 / 0x8523 / 0x8524 -> 0x200 | 0x20000 / 0x40000 / 0x10000, any other row nothing more; count 4 and entrants (0x800A958C) 4.
5 or 6: 0x40 in context 5, else 0x100, with 0x851C | 1, 0x851D | 2, 0x851E | 4, 0x851F | 8 (other rows: no count).
4: 0x80, with 0x851C -> 0x81 (count 3), 0x851E -> 0x84 (4), 0x851F -> 0x88 (4).
Any other: 0x851C -> 1 (2), 0x851D -> 2 (4), 0x851E -> 4 (3), 0x851F -> 8 (3), 0x8520 -> 0x10 (2), 0x8521 -> 0x200 with count and entrants 4, 0x8525-0x8528 -> 0x41 / 0x42 / 0x44 / 0x48, 0x8529-0x852B -> 0x81 / 0x84 / 0x88, 0x852C-0x852F -> 0x101 / 0x102 / 0x104 / 0x108 (counts 2, 4, 3, 3 by the low bit as above; 0x81 3), other rows nothing.
Callers confirm_match_setup_item, menu_start_skip_ahead (func_8010CE74), do_menu_action (func_8010DAF8). (2026-11-12, from the code.)
func_8012D918.name: set_match_type_from_row

func_8012DAF0.about: Prepares the arena's collision walls when a match is set up (called by set_up_match_memory): walks the master list at 0x8014D06C and links the wall records (the match overlay's data at 0x80146xxx, each found as zone list -> span {first, last} -> records by +0x2C next) and works out their normals (triangle_normal). mod/NOTES.md 'The collision'.
func_8012DAF0.name: link_collision_walls

func_8012DCA0.about: Sets two rows' choice bytes (+0x4C) by `mode` (1: the first keeps 1 if set, 2: both 1, 3: the first 2) and each row's +0x50 from its choice x 0x80. No callers in the converted code. (2026-11-12, names4: confirmed from the lifted C++: the name says only what the code does).
func_8012DCA0.name: set_row_pair_choice

func_8012DD2C.about: On screen `screen` (6, the PLAYER page: rows 0-7, else screen 25's rows 1-8): marks a row unselectable (+0x4A | 8) when the connected controllers (0x800F2954) are fewer than its option's need (0x8014FA0C + (label & 0xFF) x 6), moves the cursor off such a row (move_menu_cursor), and with `remember` puts the cursor on PLAYER's remembered choice (0x80158155; mod/src/logic.c lists 0x80158154.. as ORDER, PLAYER, ARENA, RULES, -, NUMBER). The menus' loop runs it on screens 6 and 25. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: eight rows (screen 6 from row 0, else from row 1), the need byte at 0x8014FA0C + (label & 0xFF) x 6 against *0x800F2954, +0x4A bit 8 set or cleared; rows labelled 0xFFFF are left alone.)
func_8012DD2C.name: disable_rows_needing_more_controllers

func_8012DE88.about: Gives the PLAYER page's rows their options from `list` (s8 option numbers ending -1): label 0x0700 + option and its def's place, shown; option 0x35 hides the row (label -1) at the middle of its neighbours. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the list walked until a negative byte; option 0x35 sets the label 0xFFFF, flag 1 and the x halfway between the neighbours' defs; others label 0x700 + option, flags & 0xFFF0, place from the def.)
func_8012DE88.name: set_player_rows_from_list

func_8012DF70.about: Seeds the match overlay's random numbers: the generator *0x80159350 from next_random_number (then `skip` more calls of it), the odd increment *0x80159354, and fills the 32-entry shuffle table 0x80159358 from lcg_random_below_1000. Caller set_up_match_memory.
func_8012DF70.name: seed_match_random

func_8012DF98.about: Sets up the PLAYER page (screen 6, mod/src/logic.c SCR_PLAYERS): picks the option list by the menus' context (func_801091F0) and the match type's bits (0x800A957C: 1, 2 tag, 4, 8, 0x200 Royal Rumble; lists 0x8014FFF0..0x8015002C), lays the rows out (set_player_rows_from_list), cursor 0, then disable_rows_needing_more_controllers(6, 1). Returns 6. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: context 4 takes 0x80150008 (kind bit 1), 0x80150010 (bit 4) or 0x80150018; others 0x8015002C for 0x200 and so on by the bits.)
func_8012DF98.name: init_player_page

func_8012DFF4.about: A random number from 0 to 999 for the match code: takes one of a pool of 32 (0x80159358, which one by the game's rand(), next_random_number (func_80036110)) and puts a fresh one in its place from the match's own generator (lcg_random_below_1000 (func_8012E07C): a linear congruential generator at 0x80159350, multiplier 0x5D588B65, scaled to 0-999).
func_8012DFF4.name: random_0_to_999

func_8012E040.about: A random yes/no: 0 when `chance` is 0, otherwise 1 when `chance` is at least a random 0-999 (random_0_to_999), so about (chance + 1) in 1000. The match code's dice roll, called from about 127 places.
func_8012E040.name: chance_in_1000

func_8012E07C.about: Steps the linear congruential generator *0x80159350 (x 0x5D588B65 + *0x80159354) until its low 20 bits / 1000 is under 1000, and returns that (0..999). Callers seed_match_random, random_0_to_999.
func_8012E07C.name: lcg_random_below_1000

func_8012E0A8.about: Keeps PLAYER choice `choice` as the page's remembered one (0x80158155) and sets the picks' controller numbers (set_pick_controllers) from the option it stands for in the context's list (as init_player_page picks it). (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: the same list choice as init_player_page (context 4: 0x80150008 / 0x80150010 / 0x80150018 by kind bits 1 / 4; otherwise 0x8015002C for 0x200 ...).)
func_8012E0A8.name: apply_player_choice

func_8012E0DC.about: The absolute value of the integer `value`. Match overlay math helper (40+ callers).
func_8012E0DC.name: int_abs

func_8012E0F0.about: The absolute value of the float `value` (fabsf). Match overlay math helper.
func_8012E0F0.name: abs_float

func_8012E13C.about: `angle + delta` wrapped into one turn of the game's 4096-step circle as a signed angle (-2048..2047), by wrap_angle (func_8012E11C).
func_8012E13C.name: add_angles

func_8012E158.about: A game angle (0x1000 a turn) to radians: times the constant at 0x801510C0 (2 pi / 4096 by use: vector_from_angle and rotate_offset_xz pass the result to sine and cosine).
func_8012E158.name: angle_to_radians

func_8012E178.about: Radians to a game angle (0x1000 a turn): times the constant at 0x801510C8, truncated; the reverse of angle_to_radians. Only caller angle_of_vector.
func_8012E178.name: radians_to_angle

func_8012E198.about: Which of 8 directions (0-7, 45 degrees each) points the opposite way to `angle`: angle_octant(angle + 0x800).
func_8012E198.name: opposite_direction_index

func_8012E1B4.about: Which of four 90-degree sectors `angle` falls in, centred on 0, 0x400, 0x800, 0xC00: ((angle + 0x1200) / 1024) & 3. Match overlay helper.
func_8012E1B4.name: angle_quadrant

func_8012E1CC.about: Which of eight 45-degree sectors `angle` falls in, centred on the multiples of 0x200: ((angle + 0x1100) / 512) & 7. Match overlay helper.

func_8012E1E4.about: Which of 8 directions (0-7, 45 degrees each, rounded to the nearest) point `b` lies in from point `a`: angle_to, then angle_octant (func_8012E1CC) ((angle + 0x1100) / 512 & 7).

func_8012E208.name: turn_angle_toward

Callers continue_without_title, title_history_action. (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: that switch is all of it.)
func_8012E270.name: next_page_after_title_choice

func_8012E294.about: The signed difference `a - b` between two angles on the game's 4096-step circle, taken the short way round (-2048..2048).
func_8012E294.name: angle_difference

func_8012E2D0.about: set_pick_controllers(`option`), then clears the select's state 0x8015B80C.
func_8012E2D0.name: set_pick_controllers_and_reset_select

func_8012E2D8.about: How two wrestlers face each other, as bits: 1 when `b` is within a quarter turn of where `a` faces (from their body points at +0x120), else 2; then 4 when `a` is within a quarter turn of where `b` faces, else 8.

func_8012F660.about:
Run every step by the move states (152 callers) for what happens as the wrestler's current animation ends. Until his record's frames left (+0xA2) is under 2 it does nothing and returns 0; then it does what `flags` asks and returns 1, the step context giving him (+0x2C) and his target (+0x30):
0x40: a reaction on him: set_current_move(him, the move at 0x8014DB00 + (flags & 0x3F)), copy_move_to_other(him, him), apply_move_damage(attacker target, victim him).
0x2000: the move passed on with its damage: with 0x4000 from the target to him (copy_move_to_other(target, him), apply_move_damage(target, him)), else from him to the target.
0x400: continue_move(step); when it takes the move on, nothing more is done.
0x80: func_800EC990 (the mod's rw_800EC990 runs in its place; the game's counts a hit of kind flags & 0x3F, 0..2, between his slot and the +0x08 slot of the man, in the per-pair tables 0x8009FDF8 / 0x8009FE18 / 0x8009FE38) for the target with 0x100, else for him.
Then always finish_animation_file(him) and clear_partner_links(him), and: with 0x200 state_after_animation(him), and with 0x800 also roll_move_aftermath(0x1000 ? target : him, target, him, 2); without 0x200 change_state(him, 48), keeping his +0x8E bit 0x40 if it was set. (Checked against the code 2026-11-12: every bit's effect above is what the code does; what each combination means in a move is the callers'.)
func_8012F660.name: on_animation_ending

rw_800EDCF4.about: The six-man engine's func_800EDCF4 (ovl_e): a wrestler going through to another area. Nothing (returns 0) when match flag 0x100000 (0x80097EC0) or rule 0x200000 (0x800A9950) is set, or when the wall he is at (+0x348's record +0x24) isn't in the door table 0x80145140 (pairs of halfwords, -1 at the end). For a listed door: +0x8C bit 0x8000; 0x8016B348 = the current area (0x80159628); the next area 0x80159670 by the door's code (0x8000 current + 10, 0x4000 current - 10, 0x2000 *0x8016B340 + 10, else code & 0xFF) and request_area_change for it; he -- and `partner` when given -- go to state 190 (set_wrestler_state), with +0xD0 = 6 / 4 for door code 0x1000 (0x8016B598 bit 4 set too) else 10000. Then the sequence list 0x80159608 (moved: one int per slot) = [his slot | 0x100 (his previous state 3, and his +0x84 bit 0) or | 0x200 with the partner's | 0x400, then every other man present, nearest first (distance_xz)]; returns 1. The original sorted up to 3 others into a stack list whose unused index 0 let six reach the saved registers. (Source: six-engine/work/rw/r_800EDCF4.c.)
rw_800EDCF4.name: start_area_change_any_count

rw_800EDE48.about: The six-man engine's func_800EDE48 (ovl_a, after a match: a challenge's condition on the player's hits): over the match's losers (result bits 0x800A10EC 0x10-0x80 for slots 0-3, the engine's word at 0x80193B74 for the rest), the player's row (slot_of_first_champion) of hit-stat matrix 0 (`flags` & 0x400: matrix 2) -- their sum, or without `flags` & 0x800 the smallest -- against `flags` & 0x300 (0: any, 0x100: none, 0x200: under 5, 0x300: under 10) -> 1 met, -1 not. The matrices are the engine's (0x80192370, see count_hit_stat), left in ovl_e's BSS after the match where no overlay's BSS or the heap reaches. (Source: six-engine/work/rw/r_800EDE48.c.)

rw_80116130.about: The six-man engine's func_80116130 (ovl_e): the camera's slot mask, a u16: bits 0-5 the slots in play (+0xA0 != -1, +0x94 bit 0 clear) and in the camera's view (+0xE9 & 0x10), 0x40 << i the slots out of play (+0x94 bit 0; every slot past the match's count n, gp, counts as out of play up to 6), 0x1000 / 0x2000 when one in view has +0x80 & 0xC0 / +0x82 & 4. rw_80117438.about: The six-man engine's rewrite of the game's func_80117438 (six-engine/work/rw/r_80117438.c: 'the match's decision -- who won'), called from it: by the end `kind` (0x800000, 0x80000 or 0x8000; `forced` 1 = a forced decision) sorts the wrestlers in play (+0xA0 != -1) into winners and losers lists and calls func_80118A20(winners, losers, flags | 0x10400, replay): for 0x800000 the man marked +0xE9 & 4 against those with & 0x10 once no one with & 0x10 is left standing, the run-in / tag cases (match flags 0x1000, 0x28000) by +0x94 & 0x200; otherwise by the teams (0x80159218), the scores +0xAA (higher wins, a tie is a draw), the per-slot values 0x80192370 / 0x8017D2F0 and the match flags (0x8000, 0x4000, 0x22000, 0x200000; rule 0x80000), with a 50% roll (chance_in_1000(500)) in one tie case. Lists have room for every slot; the slot count is the register gp, which the six-man build sets to the number of wrestlers. Returns 1 when a decision was made, else 0. (2026-11-13, names5: confirmed by the six-man engine's source (six-engine/work/rw/r_80117438.c: 'the match's decision -- who won') and the lifted C++: the wrestlers in play sorted into winners and losers for func_80118A20).

Callers the animation driver func_80012130, start_animation_stream, start_slot_animation and func_800132D8 (the mod's copy too: hooks_recomp.c keeps it, 'where it reaches the disk'). (or 0x0300..) with the state at +0x54. Advances *`in_buffer` by 0x170 and the sample count +0x70 by 0xB8 (a fixed frame); returns the next command (v0). Caller n_al_envmixer_pull.
func_8002C58C.name: n_envmixer_pull_sub_frame

func_8002C7AC.about: The second audio library's envelope rate (libultra n_env.c _getRate): the step from `volume` to `target` over `count` samples, worked out linearly ((target - volume) / count, scaled by 0x80055FE0), returned as its integer part with the fraction in *`rate_fraction` (bit 31 set when it is past 0x80055FF0).
