func_8002C7AC.name: n_envmixer_rate

func_80032314.about: The first audio library's envelope mixer, one piece of a frame (libultra env.c _pullSubFrame): unless the mixer's motion +0x48 is not 1 (playing) or `out_count` is 0, pulls its source (the handler at its source +4, through the pointer) into the sound buffer, then writes the audio commands at `commands`: the buffer set-up (0x08000000 | *`in_buffer`, the out buffers *`out_buffer` + 0x440 / 0x580 / 0x6C0 / 0x800), and when the volume changed (+0x38, cleared) the new left and right rates (envmixer_rate, by the pan table 0x80053620 and +0x18 pan, +0x1A volume, +0x1C / +0x1E targets, +0x34 samples) and the volume commands 0x0906.. / 0x0904.. / 0x0902.. / 0x0900.. / 0x0908.., then the envelope mix 0x0309.. (or 0x0308.. unchanged) with the state at +0x14. Advances *`in_buffer` by 2 x out_count and the sample count +0x30 by out_count; returns the next command (v0). Caller al_envmixer_pull.
func_80032314.name: envmixer_pull_sub_frame

func_800325E8.about: Splits `value` into a mantissa (returned, 0.5 <= |m| < 1, the sign kept) and a power of two (*`exponent`), halving while |m| >= 1 (0x800561A8 / 0x800561B0) and doubling while below 0.5 (0x800561B8); 0 gives 0 and exponent 0. libultra env.c's static _frexpf; envmixer_rate (func_800326EC) has the same code inline. No callers of its own.
func_800325E8.name: frexp_double

func_800326C8.about: Returns `value` x 2^`exponent` (as 1 << exponent; nothing for 0): libultra env.c's static _ldexpf, used by the first audio library's envelope rate (envmixer_rate (func_800326EC), where the compiler put a copy inline). No callers of its own.
func_800326C8.name: ldexp_double

func_800326EC.about: The first audio library's envelope rate (libultra env.c _getRate): the step that takes volume `volume` to `target` over `count` samples, as a 16.16 fraction: returns the integer part and puts the fraction in *`rate_fraction`. With count 0: 0x7FFF / 0xFFFF when the target is at or above the volume, else 0 / 0. Both are kept at least 1 (0x80056200); the ratio target / volume goes through frexp (the table 0x800561C0.. of 8 doubles copied to the frame and indexed by the mantissa) and is raised to 1 / count by repeated squaring. Caller envmixer_pull_sub_frame (func_80032314), for the left and right volumes.
func_800326EC.name: envmixer_rate

func_80034B50.about: libultra guAlignF(mf, a, x, y, z): fills float matrix `matrix` with the rotation that turns the axes toward the direction (`x`, `y`, `z`) (normalized first, gu_normalize) with a roll of `angle` degrees about it (x pi / 180 at 0x80053760; sine, cosine), as the identity when the direction is straight along y. Callers keep_gu_functions_linked, draw_arena_light_flares and update_match_object_models.
func_80034B50.name: gu_align_f

func_80035040.about: libultra guLookAtF(mf, eye x, y, z, at x, y, z, up x, y, z): fills float matrix `matrix` with the view from the eye toward the target with `up` as up: the look direction normalized (-1 / length, 0x80056350), the right vector up x look and the true up look x right, each normalized, and the translation -(eye . axis). Callers the camera set-ups (set_camera_view, set_camera_view_rolled, set_camera_projection_and_view), the screen bones of the pause menu, name boxes, HUD and menus, and bone_screen_position.
func_80035040.name: gu_look_at_f

func_800353C0.about: libultra guLookAt: as gu_look_at_f (the same arithmetic, its own constants 0x80056360..) into a float matrix on the frame, then converted into the fixed-point Mtx `mtx` (gu_mtx_float_to_fixed). No callers in the game's code.
func_800353C0.name: gu_look_at

func_80036AD0.about: Formats `format` and the arguments after it into `buffer` (libc sprintf): the printf engine printf_engine (func_8003D810) with the copy-out function 0x80036B28 and the arguments on the stack; a nul is put after the text when the length is not negative, and the length is returned. Used by the menus and the editor (47 callers) for numbers and names.
func_80036AD0.name: format_string

func_80037920.about: libultra osSetTimer(timer, countdown, interval, queue, message): fills `timer` (+0x10 the 64-bit countdown, or the interval when it is 0; +8 the interval; +0x18 the queue, +0x1C the message), and with interrupts off takes the time gone since the last timer interrupt (osGetCount - 0x800A8950) off the first running timer, inserts this one (insert_timer) and arms the interrupt for the first (set_timer_intr). Returns 0. Callers gb_pak_init and gb_pak_power (their waits).
func_80037920.name: set_timer

func_80037AA4.about: libultra __osTimerInterrupt (called by vi_manager_thread on a counter interrupt): takes the time gone (osGetCount against 0x800A8950, which it updates) off the first running timer; while one has run out, takes it off the list, sends its message to its queue (osSendMesg, not blocking) and puts it back with its interval when it repeats (insert_timer); arms the interrupt for the next one (set_timer_intr), or with none left clears the compare (func_8003E290) and 0x800A8950.
func_80037AA4.name: timer_interrupt

func_80037C60.about: libultra __osInsertTimer: with interrupts off, puts timer `timer` into the running list (head *0x800537E0, sorted by time left: each timer's +0x10 / +0x14 64-bit value is what is left after the one before), taking the earlier timers' values off its own and its value off the one it goes before; returns the high word of what is left (v0 of the 64-bit result). Callers set_timer (osSetTimer) and timer_interrupt (a repeating timer put back).
func_80037C60.name: insert_timer

func_8003D810.about: The C library's printf core (_Printf(output, state, format, arguments)): copies the text up to each '%' out through `output` (called through its pointer, with `state`; it returns the new state, 0 to stop), then reads the flags (find_character in ' +-#0' at 0x80056480, their bits 0x80056488), width and precision ('*' from the arguments), the size letter, and the field itself (printf_put_field), counting what was written; returns the count, or -1 when the output stopped. Caller format_string (sprintf).
func_8003D810.name: printf_engine

func_800DA2EC.about: The front end's model set-up (run_front_end): the animation streams (init_animation_streams), 0x8009EDD4 = 0, the four scene actors (allocate_scene_actors), the match objects' models (load_match_object_models), then for model slots 0-3 Superstar 0 in costume 0 (build_slot_model) and func_80014E44(slot, 0x80); with 0x80097FD8 set func_8001B220(*0x800BD5A0); colour on (set_colour_mode(1)) and the arena hidden (show_arena(0)).

func_800DB2A4.about: Draws a large image as texture-rectangle tiles of 64 x 48 (24 rows for a 16-bit image, `format_16bit` set) into the display list *`display_list`, each tile loaded with load_texture_tile, scaled from the image's size (`image_width` x `image_height`) to the size on screen (`width` x `height`) and, with `angle` not 0, turned by it (sine / cosine of angle x 0x80103268) about the picture's middle. Callers draw_picture_script, draw_intro_picture_loop and draw_intro_layer. The order of the middle arguments is a reading of their use, not settled. (2026-11-13, names5: confirmed from the lifted C++: 64 x 48 texture-rectangle tiles (load_texture_tile), scaled and turned by the angle's sine and cosine; the order of the middle arguments stays a reading). (2026-11-14, fablenames2 continuation: locals named from each one's defining expression (all of them were listed and read; the control flow between them was not). Each tile (tile_left / top / right / bottom in texels) is scaled, taken relative to the image's half width and height, turned by the angle (the products with sin_angle / cos_angle) and placed around (centre_x, centre_y) with the x offsets times 1.5; the four corners go into vertices as quarter-pixel positions.)

func_800DD5A4.about: Asks for text `text` at (`x`, `y`) this frame: marks a text with no flag in its top four bits 0x10000000, finds or takes its text item (text_item_for_text when `flags` has 0x8000, else text_item_for_key by `key`), and puts it in the frame's draw requests with `flags` (add_text_draw_request); returns that's result, or 0 with no item free. request_text / request_string and the save, league, credits, entrance and winner screens call it.

func_800DEDE0.about: The match HUD's per-frame update of the players' panels (update_match_hud; hooks_recomp.c: 'the match HUD's per-frame update (ovl_e func_800DEDE0)'): from area 3 on keeps the men in view (func_80116130 & 0x3F at 0x80158E96), then for each of the 0x80158E98 panels places its quads (place_hud_quad_points) by its controller (0x8054B7A0) and the HUD layout 0x8016DE70: the spirit / SPECIAL meter (hud_spirit_values, slot_special_lit), the marks of a dazed, bleeding or held man (slots_marked_8c_800_mask), the tag partner outside (non_legal_man_free_to_act), and func_800EE130. The mod hooks its return (arcade_on_hud: an empty Rumble slot has no panel); the six-man engine widens its corner masks (rw/hud.c). (2026-11-14, fablenames2 continuation: locals named from the code; the first 330 of about 450 rendered lines were read line by line, the rest from the defining lines. Per player: the panel layout (0x8016DE70 + player) is chosen from the in-view bits (func_80116130() & 0x3F, kept at 0x80158E96), the controller and the slot's bit 1, + 10 while SPECIAL is lit, and its eight words copied from the table 0x80154A0C when it changes; the spirit shown (hud_spirit_values into 0x8016B9F4) sets a rise / fall flash (panel flag 0x40 / 0x80, six steps) when it moved; three colour levels follow the spirit by square roots -- colour_low falls to 0 at spirit 40, colour_mid peaks there, colour_high rises from 40 to 100 -- and are blended toward a flash colour and halved for a man not in view; a pulse (period 5 at spirit 100, longer below) sizes the SPECIAL quad placed with place_hud_quad_points. That the three levels are blue, green and red is likely from the ramp but the store that would show it was not read.)
func_800DEDE0.name: update_hud_panels

func_800E2344.about: The match camera each frame (caller func_800E1E60; mod/src/arena_ringstage.c 'func_800E1E60 -> func_800E2344 (the frame's camera)'): the first frame (0x801594D2 -1) only resets it; otherwise lists the slots in play (0x801898D0 >= 0) with their places mirrored (wrestler_place_mirrored), keeps those in view (func_80116130, rw_cam_view_a1) and, in the modes 0x01C00000 when controller 1 drives another slot (pad1_has_other_slot), all in play (slots_in_play_mask); then picks the shot: special shots (special_camera_shot, frame_camera_on_men (func_800E30D8), two_man_ring_camera (func_800E38A4)), keep all in view (match_camera_keep_all_in_view), by targets (target_slot_of) and holds (wrestler_is_weak). func_800E299C.about: Packs costume record `record` into the save's 0x44 bytes at `destination` (mod/src/bigshow.c: 'packs a wrestler for the save with func_800E299C(dest, record)'): its 0x17 bytes from +0x31 to +0x2D, its three names 7 bits a character (pack_text_7bit: 20 from +0 to +0, 10 from +0x15 to +0x12, 16 from +0x20 to +0x1B), then +0x29..+0x2C cleared and packed with +0x48 (u16), +0x4A, +0x4B and +0x4C at the widths 0x800F5E50..0x800F5E53 (pack_bits). Callers fill_save_with_defaults, pack_default_created_superstars, save_created_superstars_to_pak and func_800E31C4 / func_800E3330; the mod's roster.c packs its own Superstars' costumes with it.

func_800E30D8.name: frame_camera_on_men

func_800E38A4.about: The match camera's shot for two men in the ring (update_match_camera; mod/src/arena_ringstage.c: 'the ring's two men go to func_800E38A4'): from the pair `pair` (two slots, u16) and their places (0x8017C870, 0x14 apart) takes the larger of their gaps in x (scaled by 0x8014E358), y and z, the angle between them (arc_tangent_2, wrap_radians), each man's state for the shot (camera_state_bits) and target (target_slot_of), and sets the eye and target from them, with some random choice (next_random_number), kept inside the area (inside_area_bounds), eased toward (ease_toward) and set as the frame's camera (set_frame_camera). In the six-man engine the slots are tested against rw_cam_view (rw_cam_view_s5). func_800E38A4.name: two_man_ring_camera

(2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: *0x8009ED18 capped at 0x7FFF, 0x80104C00 = -1 / 0x80104C04 = 0 each frame, then a switch over steps 1-0x75 (`arg0` is the step).)

The node *0x80097F14's +0xB goes with it. Callers fill_cast_names and the story match set-ups. mod/NOTES.md: 'takes the first not excluded'; the mod hooks it (hooks_recomp.c bigshow_on_story_part).

func_800EED7C.about: A move's step for the attacker (the step context `step`: +0x2C his record, +0x30 the man he holds; phase his +0x18), from a state table (no direct callers): 0 starts animation 0x321B and a turn rate +0x298 that brings him round to face away from his corner (+0xCC, the angles 0x8014D1D8) over the move's frames; 1 turns both by it, keeps the man 73.5 in front (rotate_offset_xz) and, on the last frame, sets a drift of 9 along the corner's angle (vector_from_angle into +0x288) and starts 0x321D; 2 moves him by the drift (move_wrestler_by) until his body point's x or z (by corner) is past 0x8014E9D8, then marks +0x9C and starts 0x321F (0x3221 when the man has +0xF0 bit 2); 3 and 4 push both out of the walls until frame 14 / 45 and end (on_animation_ending, 4 with 0x264). Both are pushed out of the walls together each step (push_out_of_walls_carrying). Which move it is is not established. (2026-11-14, fablenames2: which move it is IS established by the files: it is wrestler state 194's step, the attacker of the 194 / 195 pair that the whipper (wrestler_state_11_whipper) starts in a cage match with set_pair_states(0xC2, 0xC3). wrestler_state_195_cage_whip_corner_man's about says '194 plays 0x321B / 0x321D / 0x321F / 0x3221', exactly the four files this function starts, and 195 plays the next file of each (0x321C, 0x321E, then 'the attacker's file + 1'), follows this function's slide (+0x288) and reads the two bits it sets in his +0x9C (bit 0 when he reaches the corner, bit 1 when the man's tie-up bit 2 is up). Renamed from carry_man_to_corner_step. Not checked: the entry 194 of the table 0x80144CF0 itself (no ROM here).)
func_800EED7C.name: wrestler_state_194_cage_whip_corner_attacker

The mod hooks its return (qa_hook_demo_flags, arcade_on_demo_setup).
func_800EF478.name: set_up_demo_match

func_800EFFD4.about: Draws `count` line pictures `lines` (each a picture record: +4 its image, +0xC width, +0xE height) into the display list *`display_list`, each centred across the 480-wide screen and 16 rows below the last, from y 0x68 - 16 x count (so the block is centred about 0x68), through draw_image_in_tiles. The answer is returned (v0). The mod hooks its return (logic.c: Multi Play's Royal Rumble).

func_80116AC4.about: The match clock each step (from func_80114514): ticks the clocks 0x801595F8 and 0x8016B930 (tick_clock at rate 30); each whole second moves the move tallies on (advance_move_tallies) and, with rule 0x200 (0x800A9950) from minute 10, may set the run-in marks 0x8016B650 |= 0x30 (500 in 1000; with match flag 0x400000 the first time 250 in 1000, marking 0x400). With no time limit (0x8009FE6C 0) the clock wraps at 10000 minutes and the other at 60 and is shown counting up (func_800DFED0(seconds, minutes)); with one it is shown counting down to the limit (0x80146574[limit] minutes, rule 0x80000) or as it is, and at the limit the match ends: a demo (0x02000000) marks 0x8016B599 |= 0x10, else sound 1 (play_menu_sound) and func_80117438(0x8000).
func_80116AC4.name: tick_match_clock

func_80117A84.about: The menus' text and overlays into the display list *`display_list` each frame (run_menu_frame; mod/src/logic.c: 'ovl_a func_800DD5A4 requests, ovl_c func_80117A84 draws them'): flips the vertex buffer 0x80149FB0, places at the menu camera's target (position_at_menu_camera_target), then a black fade first when `fade` is below 0; the 0x60 draw requests at *0x8010581C (12 bytes: +0 the text item, +4 its level, +6 flags, +8 'asked again this frame'): each with a level is drawn at it (draw_text_request, func_80117714) and faded by text_fade_step unless asked again, one not asked again with flag 8 cut to 0; one at -5 or below is dropped (drop_text_draw_request). func_80117F28.about: The match loop's wrestler part of a step (from func_80114514), as the six-man engine has it (its stubs rw_wrap_s1_v0, rw_wrap_v0_v0, rw_t1_a1_n20 for any count of slots): `phase` 0 resets the round-robin start 0x801591F8 and the slots' state histories (0x80187DB0, 16 s16 each); phase 1 clears bits 0x12 of each wrestler's +0x88, runs func_8012FEDC, then reads the controls (read_slot_controls) round the slots from the start in turn -- first the men in a hold (+0x68 bit 2) with their partners, then the rest, then those flagged bit 0 -- with the match objects moved between (move_match_objects, flag 8); moves the start on, turns each man flagged 0x200 toward his target (turn_toward, 0x155 a step), frees spent effects, checks landings on objects, sets the human flags 0x8051C100 from +0x8017FFD9 bit 3, poses everyone (pose_all_wrestlers), runs func_8013092C, and pushes each slot's state into its history when it changed (states 1 and 0x30 apart). (2026-11-12, names3: confirmed from the lifted C++: phase 1 starts by clearing bits 0x12 of +0x88 (0x8017FF78 + 0x358 x n) for the gp slots.)

func_8012069C.about: The strikes' hit test (called by the striking states 7, 8, 26, 31-44, 97, 98, 191 and more): unless `kind` is 0x18, only while his move's frame +0xA4 is within the hit window +0x2F0..+0x2F1; builds the list of possible targets (build_action_target_list, through the six-man engine's rw_tl_call, on the frame at sp+0x10) and measures each against his reach (distance_xz from the striking body point; match objects by their shape, object_span_from_wrestler), keeping the nearest in reach. mod/NOTES.md: its frame grew in the six-man engine for the bigger target list (patch_target_list.py). It returns the slot of the man it keeps (-1 for none), which the callers test against -1 and pass to apply_strike_to_target; `object` is 0 in every call but the one with kind 0x18, which passes a match object that object_span_from_wrestler measures. (2026-11-14, fablenames2 continuation: the remaining locals named from their lines; this function was mostly named already. object_radius is 60 for a match object candidate; a wrestler candidate's low and high are his lowest body point and that plus his height word (0x80188950-block, +0x70 a slot).)

Callers the run and its contacts (resolve_running_contact 'func_8012BF50 finds it', choose_run_heading, blocked_ahead, try_c_down_run) and the states that step over or strike lying men.

func_8012C474.about: The match's body contact worker, func_8012C474(wrestler, man, radius, side mask, except, mode) as its callers name the arguments (find_touching_wrestler, find_touching_wrestler_except, keep_apart_from_others(_masked), keep_apart_during_move, keep_apart_for_phase, touch_and_push_man_until_frame, probe_contact_moved_by): fills the contact list (func_800EBD2C; in the six-man engine at rw_contacts, rw_contacts_s0) and for each contact but `except` measures the overlap of the two body ellipses (ellipse_radius_toward both ways, more for a lying or thrown man: 0x80151040); for each that overlaps, with `mode` set, adds a push away from it along the angle between them (vector_from_angle; a man on the ropes 0x400 pushed along his facing, mode 2 turned by -0x200 for men) to the total, its x / z kept by the side mask (0xF00 when 0: 0x300 across x, 0xC00 across z) and divided by `radius`. Remembers the first contact (a match object, 100 and up, also at +0x44). With mode set and the man not on the ropes moves him (and `man` with him) by the total, at most 7.5 (length_xz, 0x80151050). Returns the first contact or -1 (v0).
func_8012C474.name: touch_and_push_worker

func_8013843C.name: simulate_match_result

func_8013AF04.about: Walks the byte list at `list` (+0 a kind, then entries; 0xFF starts a new kind; 0 ends) and returns 1 as soon as an entry matches `pair` (two words): kinds 10 / 22 one byte against pair[0]; kinds 9 / 11 / 23 / 25 two bytes against the pair either way round; kinds 12 / 24 pair[0] == 0, or the byte - 1 against always_zero_8000A7D0's 0. No callers: unused code left in ovl_e. What the kinds are is not established. func_800EBD2C.about: Fills the contact list of `wrestler` at `list` (0x28-byte entries, up to 10 props; wrestler_body_extent, measure_between_points): the other men and props he touches, for the keep-apart and push code. Caller touch_and_push_worker (whose about: 'fills the contact list (func_800EBD2C)'). (mod/NOTES.md: 'func_800EBD2C's contact list'.)
func_800EBD2C.name: fill_contact_list

func_800EC484.about: With `flags` bit 0, makes `wrestler` target the nearest other wrestler in play (distance_xz from his body point; neither his current target +8 nor +0xC) and returns 1; 0 when there is none. Callers wrestler_state_1_standing, wrestler_state_79_knocked_down, wrestler_state_174_177_on_ladder, set_up_match_wrestlers. (mod/src/arcade.h GF_RETARGET: 'func_800EC484(wrestler, 1) -> 1: the wrestler turns to the nearest other one'.)
func_800EC484.name: turn_to_nearest_wrestler

func_800EC698.about: Wrestler `wrestler` goes into moveset entry `entry` of slot `owner`: counts repeats of the same entry (+0x306, the last one +0x308, the previous kept in +0x30E), sets the owner (+0x304) and copies the entry's move record from the moveset tables (0x800AA090 + entry x 0x24, by the owner's slot) into his record. Callers pick_front_grapple_action, continue_move, start_move_turnaround, the taunts and many states. (mod/src/movex.c: 'func_800EC698(w, owner, entry)'; mod/src/logic.c 'a wrestler going into a moveset entry'.)
func_800EC698.name: start_moveset_entry

func_800EC940.about: Clears model `model`'s row in the three hit-stat matrices (4 x 4 halfwords at 0x8009FDF8, +0x20, +0x40). Caller set_up_wrestler_slot. (The six-man engine's rewrite clear_hit_stat_row describes the original.)
func_800EC940.name: clear_hit_stats_of_model

func_800EC990.about: Counts one into the hit-stat matrices (4 x 4 halfwords from 0x8009FDF8, by kind: 0 at 0x8009FDF8, 1 at +0x20, 2 at +0x40): [his model][his model] (his model +0x9E) and [his model][the other man's model], each held at 0xFFFF. Callers the move and strike states (wrestler_state_86_move_receiver, apply_strike_to_target and about 20 more). The six-man engine's clear_hit_stat_row clears the same matrices. What each kind counts is not established.
func_800EC990.name: add_hit_stat

func_800ED130.about: Sets the story's current node `n` (its number 0x80097ED4, the node *0x80097F14). Callers advance_story, start_new_story. (mod/src/story.c story_set_node: 'func_800ED130(n): the story's current node'.)
func_800ED130.name: set_story_node

func_800EE130.about: Two slot masks in one u16 over the four slots: bits 4-7 the men in state 196 (wrestler_state_196_climb_over_cage_top), bits 0-3 those in state 189 (wrestler_state_189_grab_prize_atop_ladder) at phase 3. Caller update_hud_panels. (The six-man engine's rewrite slots_in_states_c4_bd_mask describes the original; reading them as the cage escape and the prize grab is from the state names.)
func_800EE130.name: cage_escape_and_prize_slot_masks

func_800EE1F0.about: Which way the story goes after a match. Caller check_story_retries. (mod/src/story.c story_branch: 'func_800EE1F0(): which way the story goes after a match'.)
func_800EE1F0.name: story_branch

func_800EE3EC.name: story_rumble_entrants

func_80109F88.about: Picks and sets up the entrance sequence's step `step` actually played (ovl_b; `in_scene` 1 inside a story scene): per entrant, the video (entrance_video, select_entrance_video), the style and walk path, the effects (trigger_effect_group), the close shot by venue (0x801257B8[3 v]), the arena or close scene shown; returns the step. Callers advance_entrance_sequence, reset_entrance_sequence, start_scene_entrance, play_scene_script. (mod/src/logic.c: 'the entrance's next step picked (ovl_b func_80109F88)'.)
func_80109F88.name: pick_entrance_step

func_8010A9E8.about: The Superstar Select's Random (C-up): draws a roster ordinal at random (rand() % 65) and takes a Superstar on the pages who can be picked. Caller run_menus_main_loop. (Its mod copy's about; mod/gen/patches.py.)
func_8010A9E8.name: random_superstar_pick

func_8010C998.about: Picks the entrance's Titantron video `video` (-1 for the entrant's own) and sets up its pictures and effects from the entrance table. Callers run_entrance_step, run_scene_commands, wait_scene_command. (mod/src/media.c media_video_select: 'func_8010C998(video): the entrance's video picked'.)
func_8010C998.name: select_entrance_video

func_8010D1E0.about: The scene script's op 0x7F test for `command` (ovl_b): whether the condition holds, by which run_scene_commands skips commands. Caller run_scene_commands. (mod/src/story.c story_scene_cond: 'func_8010D1E0(command): the scene script's op 0x7F test'.)
func_8010D1E0.name: scene_condition

func_80110D7C.about: The running state's step at a wall (for `step`, with `mode`): a solid wall or prop ahead sends him to state 21 (wrestler_state_21_crash_into_wall), a door wall (kind 0x200) to the next area (start_area_change), ropes and corners to their states. Callers wrestler_state_3_running, wrestler_state_30_after_dodge, may_springboard_now. (Its mod copy's about, confirmed from the lifted C++ and mod/gen/patches.py.)
func_80110D7C.name: running_wall_step

func_801144EC.about: The Superstar Select's name panel (called by draw_text_request): picture 0x459B centred at (0xC0, 0xC6), grown to `scale` / 255 of its full 0xB6 x 0x1C (draw_tinted_picture_tiles; tint 3 for an ordinal 0x41..0x65, the created slots, else 4), then while the flash counter 0x8014A4E0 runs picture 0x459F widening and fading. (Its mod copy draw_select_name_panel_and_flash's about; mod/gen/patches.py: 'the Superstar Select's name panel'.)
func_801144EC.name: draw_select_name_panel

func_80114514.about: One step of the match's logic, once a frame (the match loop's): by the match state 0x801591FC (0 set-up, 1 the lead-in, 2 the match ...) sets up the match objects and wrestlers (set_up_match_objects, set_up_match_wrestlers), runs the wrestlers' step (update_match_wrestlers_step), the clock, the count-out (update_count_out) and the pin count's HUD. Callers run_match, set_up_match_memory. (mod/src/arcade.h GF_MATCH_STEP: 'func_80114514(): one step of the match's logic'.)
func_80114514.name: run_match_step

func_80116130.about: The camera's slot mask, a u16: bits 0-3 the slots in play and in the camera's view (+0xE9 & 0x10), 0x40 << i (then the next bits) the slots out of play (+0x94 bit 0), 0x1000 / 0x2000 for a man in view with +0x80 & 0xC0 / +0x82 & 4. Callers match_camera_keep_all_in_view, frame_camera_on_men, two_man_ring_camera, update_hud_panels. (The six-man engine's rewrite camera_slot_mask_any_count describes the original.)
func_80116130.name: camera_slot_mask

func_8011723C.about: Slot `slot` eliminated, and whether the match is over. Caller match_end_check. (mod/src/logic.c arcade_elim_check: 'func_8011723C(slot): a slot eliminated, and whether the match is over -- the game's function'.)
func_8011723C.name: eliminate_slot

func_80117438.about: The match's decision, who won, by the end `kind` (0x8000 time up, 0x80000 count-out, 0x800000 and others) and `forced`: sorts the wrestlers in play into winners and losers and ends the match with them (end_match_with_result). Callers tick_match_clock, update_count_out, match_end_check. (The six-man engine's rewrite rw_decide_match_result: 'the match's decision -- who won'; mod/src/story.c.)
func_80117438.name: decide_match_result

func_80118A20.about: Ends the match with a result: the winners' and losers' slot lists `winners` / `losers` and the end flags `how`; with `tally` the result is counted first (tally_match_result); notes the reason (note_match_end_reason), eliminates and records. Callers match_end_check, end_match_from_pause_menu, the six-man engine's rw_decide_match_result. (mod/src/arcade.h GF_ELIMINATE: 'func_80118A20(winners*, losers*, how, 0): the match's own elimination'.)
func_80118A20.name: end_match_with_result

func_801199F0.name: next_rumble_entrant

func_8011DCC4.name: draw_vs_name_panel

func_80123588.about: A menu row drawer (ovl_c) that draws a Superstar's photo (pictures 0x45B3 on, by superstar_photo_number) in a pulsing frame (draw_pulsing_row_frame) with story_championship_percent_seen. Caller draw_menu_row. (mod/gen/patches.py: 'photo files'.)
func_80123588.name: draw_superstar_row_photo

func_8012BBB0.name: draw_superstar_photo_row

func_8012CB8C.about: The wall mover: tests a wrestler's movement against the walls of his zone (the ring's zone table 0x8014D290 by quadrant, quadrant_of_vector; collide_with_wall_records), works out the push (vector_scale, vector_add) and, with `apply`, moves him and the men he carries (move_wrestler_by); returns the kinds of wall hit (his nearest wall in +0x348). Callers push_out_of_walls and its variants, wall_hit_at_offset. (push_out_of_walls: 'func_8012CB8C(wrestler, -, -, softness, -, -, -, wall_mask, mode, apply)'.)
func_8012CB8C.name: push_out_of_walls_worker

func_8012DDD8.about: The floor at point (`x`, `z`): finds the floor zone the point is in (the floor zones 0x8014DA6C by area, quadrant_of_vector, segment_hits_wall_quad on a vertical line from 10000 to -10000) and returns its height (projection_along), writing the zone to `out` when given. Callers ai_plan_133_take_ladder, collide_object_with_walls, place_slot_ground_parts. (mod/NOTES.md: 'the floor zones 0x8014DA6C[row] (func_8012DDD8 ...)'.)
func_8012DDD8.name: floor_zone_at_point

func_8012F9CC.about: A man's pose for the frame: hands his place, his animation file and frame to the animation driver (animation_driver) and takes his bones' places back, with his head turned toward `head_target`. Caller pose_all_wrestlers. (mod/gen/patches.py: 'a man's pose'; its mod copy adds the ground's lift.)
func_8012F9CC.name: pose_wrestler_for_frame

func_8012FEDC.about: Each of the four wrestlers' body points from his model (the models at 0x805254A0, 0xB24 each): bones 1..19's places into his record +0x120.. (12 bytes each), +0x120 itself the middle of bones 1 and 23. Caller update_match_wrestlers_step. (The six-man engine's rewrite copy_body_points_from_models describes the original.)
func_8012FEDC.name: copy_body_points

func_80130878.about: The animation file of the move wrestler `wrestler` is in: the move's entry (+0x30A) looked up in the table 0x8015A700 (s16) plus 0x3322 plus `who` (0 the attacker's file, 1 the man's). About 100 call sites in the move and state code (continue_move, start_move_turnaround, the taunt and grapple states). The mod replaces it (mod/src/movex.c movex_anim: 'func_80130878(wrestler, 0 attacker / 1 defender): the animation file of the move he's in').
func_80130878.name: move_animation

func_8013092C.about: The instant replay's recorder, each match frame: one sample per wrestler and per prop into the replay rings, then whether a replay is due and its start. Caller update_match_wrestlers_step. (The six-man engine's rewrite record_replay_frame_any_count describes the original.)
func_8013092C.name: record_replay_frame

func_8013C5B0.about: Builds the data page's list of Superstars (screen 13 tab 2), by `kind`: walks the select pages' Superstars (select_page_superstar, superstar_exists, select_box_ordinal) into the list; returns the row's kind data. Callers show_data_page_tab_2_list, data_page_action. (mod/gen/patches.py: 'the Superstars' list from them all'.)
func_8013C5B0.name: build_data_page_superstar_list

func_8013F820.about: Returns 0 when a wrestler of the same group as `wrestler` (+0xCC equal; empty slots skipped) is in a blocking state -- state 24 (in the corner) at a phase under 5, 10, 28 or 116, or +0xEC bit 8 -- else 1; for the first four slots. Callers try_climb_turnbuckle, wrestler_state_53_staggering_back, running_wall_step. (The six-man engine's rewrite, group_free_of_blocking_states, reads the same; +0xCC is his corner there.)
func_8013F820.name: corner_group_free

func_8013FEF4.name: knocked_down_animation
